152831.name: Adventure Time
152831.overview: Unlikely heroes Finn and Jake are buddies who traverse the mystical Land of Ooo. The best of friends, our heroes always find themselves in the middle of escapades. Finn and Jake depend on each other through thick and thin.

similar.name: My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic
The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball

1-1.title: Slumber Party Panic
1-1.overview: Finn and Princess Bubblegum must protect the Candy Kingdom from a horde of candy zombies they accidentally created.

1-2.title: Trouble in Lumpy Space
1-2.overview: Finn must travel to Lumpy Space to find a cure that will save Jake, who was accidentally bitten by Lumpy Space Princess at a tea party.

1-3.title: Prisoners of Love
1-3.overview: When the Ice King kidnaps a number of princesses he sees as potential brides, Finn and Jake team with the prisoners to set everybody free.

1-4.title: Tree Trunks
1-4.overview: Finn and Jake join Tree Trunks in search for the rare Crystal Gem Apple, but question whether Tree Trunks has what it takes to adventure.

1-5.title: The Enchiridion!
1-5.overview: Finn and Jake go on a quest for a magical book that would prove them worthy of being righteous heroes.

1-6.title: The Jiggler
1-6.overview: A jiggly creature attracted by Finn's auto-tuned singing follows Finn and Jake home but soon feels ill effects of separation from its family.

1-7.title: Ricardio the Heart Guy
1-7.overview: When a Heart Guy named Ricardio comes to Candy Kingdom, Finn gets really jealous and finds a way to get him out of the Land of Ooo.

1-8.title: Business Time
1-8.overview: When Finn and Jake discover a group of businessmen frozen in an iceberg, the duo thaws them and hires them to help with their adventures.

1-9.title: My Two Favorite People
1-9.overview: Jake's plan to spend time with both Lady Rainicorn and Finn backfires.

1-10.title: Memories of Boom Boom Mountain
1-10.overview: Finn reflects on an upsetting experience in his past and pledges to help everyone in town, but this proves more difficult than imagined.

1-11.title: Wizard
1-11.overview: Finn and Jake temporarily get magic powers from an evil wizard, but are tricked into helping stop a comet.

1-12.title: Evicted!
1-12.overview: Finn and Jake search the land of Ooo for a new home after Marceline claims the duo's treehouse as her own.

1-13.title: City of Thieves
1-13.overview: Finn and Jake go off to face a thief king who has been stealing from little girls.

1-14.title: The Witch's Garden
1-14.overview: Finn and Jake consider breaking up after a witch strips Jake of his powers.

1-15.title: What Is Life?
1-15.overview: Finn brings a pie-throwing robot to life, but the machine begins to long for a more fulfilling existence.

1-16.title: Ocean of Fear
1-16.overview: Finn struggles to overcome his fear of the ocean.

1-17.title: When Wedding Bells Thaw
1-17.overview: The Ice King gets married but not before he convinces Finn and Jake to throw him a manlorette party.

1-18.title: Dungeon
1-18.overview: Finn's headstrong decision to explore a dungeon in defiance of Jake's warnings leads to a dangerous escapade.

1-19.title: The Duke
1-19.overview: Finn must tell the truth when he accidentally turns Princess Bubblegum bald and green and blames the Duke of Nuts.

1-20.title: Freak City
1-20.overview: After being transformed into a foot, Finn joins forces with a band of misfits to make things right.

1-21.title: Donny
1-21.overview: Finn and Jake try to help an obnoxious grass ogre named Donny develop better social skills, only to find out Donny's jerky behavior protects the house people from the why-wolves, which eat the house people.

1-22.title: Henchman
1-22.overview: After seeing Marceline the vampire queen torment an elderly henchman, Finn steps in to be her new henchman, doing whatever he is told to do.

1-23.title: Rainy Day Daydream
1-23.overview: Stuck inside the treehouse due to a knife storm, Finn and Jake use their imagination to pass the time.

1-24.title: What Have You Done?
1-24.overview: Finn and Jake capture the Ice King as their prisoner, but feel guilty when unable to explain the wrongs he committed.

1-25.title: His Hero
1-25.overview: The great warrior Billy inspires Finn and Jake to practice nonviolence, but the duo finds it difficult to resist old ways.

1-26.title: Gut Grinder
1-26.overview: When the Fluffy People's gold has been devoured by a culprit only known as "The Gut Grinder", Finn and Jake team up to find him with his tracks.

2-1.title: It Came from the Nightosphere
2-1.overview: Marceline's evil father goes on a soul-sucking rampage after Finn and Marceline accidentally release him from the Nightosphere.

2-2.title: The Eyes
2-2.overview: Finn and Jake try to rid themselves of a weird horse that creeps them out.

2-3.title: Loyalty to the King
2-3.overview: Finn and Jake are excited to meet the Nice King who has come to Ooo. They soon realize that he looks suspiciously like someone else they know; the Ice King.

2-4.title: Blood Under the Skin
2-4.overview: When Finn gets a splinter on his finger, he wants to get the best armor. In order to receive it, he must go on a quest to get the Magical Armor of Zelderon and survive one embarrassing situation after another.

2-5.title: Storytelling
2-5.overview: Jake is sick and demands to hear a good story full of romance, fighting and suspense.

2-6.title: Slow Love
2-6.overview: Finn and Jake agree to help a snail named Snorlock find a girlfriend.

2-7.title: Power Animal
2-7.overview: Finn is captured by gnomes who want to use his energy to power their infernal machines, and it's up to Jake to stay focused and rescue him.

2-8.title: Crystals Have Power
2-8.overview: Jake takes a pledge of nonviolence just before Finn is kidnapped by outlaws from the crystalline dimension.

2-9.title: The Other Tarts
2-9.overview: Finn choses to cross the Desert of Doom to deliver the royal tarts to the annual back rubbing ceremony.

2-10.title: To Cut a Woman's Hair
2-10.overview: A tree witch demands a lock of princess hair or else Jake will be sucked into her bottomless bottom.

2-11.title: The Chamber of Frozen Blades
2-11.overview: Whilst the Ice King goes out to take Gunther to the hospital, Finn and Jake decide to sneak inside his lair and flex their ninja skills.

2-12.title: Her Parents
2-12.overview: Jake's relationship with Lady Rainicorn is in danger when he promises to meet with her parents, as both species had a long history of war with each other. However, thanks to Jake's shape-shifting powers, they mistake the dog as one of their own, but for how long?

2-13.title: The Pods
2-13.overview: Finn and Jake discover a box containing three beans. Planting them causes three pods to grow. Two of them are good and one is evil, but which is which?

2-14.title: The Silent King
2-14.overview: After defeating a evil king of goblins, Finn finds himself crowned as their new king. Unfortunately, he's unable to do anything for them due to the rules of the previous king including defending the goblins from the previous king.

2-15.title: The Real You
2-15.overview: Finn has to give a speech at Princess Bubblegum's science barbecue and seeks a quick fix to make himself smarter.

2-16.title: Guardians of Sunshine
2-16.overview: Finn and Jake get sucked into one of BMO's games and they have to defeat all three of his bosses.

2-17.title: Death in Bloom
2-17.overview: After killing Princess Bubblegum's plant when left to take care of it, Finn and Jake make a trip to the Land of the Dead in order to get it's soul back.

2-18.title: Susan Strong
2-18.overview: Finn is excited to discover what appears to be a tribe of humans living underground near the Candy Kingdom, but gets more than he expected when he tries to teach one of them about the surface world.

2-19.title: Mystery Train
2-19.overview: Wanting to surprise Finn on his birthday, Jake takes Finn on a train, where they get wrapped up in a murder mystery.

2-20.title: Go with Me
2-20.overview: Marceline and Jake give Finn advice so he can ask Princess Bubblegum to see a movie with him.

2-21.title: Belly of the Beast
2-21.overview: In order to cure the stomach ache of a giant, Finn and Jake must break up a party happening in his belly.

2-22.title: The Limit
2-22.overview: On a mission to save soldiers of the Hot Dog Princess, Finn and Jake go inside a massive maze where wishes can be granted and where Jake's stretching powers are pushed to their limits.

2-23.title: Video Makers
2-23.overview: After discovering government warnings prior to movies for their film club, Finn and Jake decide to make their own, but get into a fight over the direction of their film.

2-24.title: Mortal Folly
2-24.overview: When the Lich is accidentally freed from its amber prison in Princess Bubblegum's Castle, Finn and Jake must head forth to stop it from regaining its full power, all while being pestered by the Ice King to give him their blessing to marry Princess Bubblegum.

2-25.title: Mortal Recoil
2-25.overview: Princess Bubblegum recovers from being dropped in the Well of Power by the Ice King; however, she is altered and her condition leads to an unlikely final showdown with one of the greatest evils in order to save all life in Ooo.

2-26.title: Heat Signature
2-26.overview: Marceline plays a prank on Finn and Jake by making them believe they're vampires, but it goes too far and escalates when they're manipulated by her ghost friends.

3-1.title: Conquest of Cuteness
3-1.overview: Finn and Jake must defend their home from the Cuties, a tiny race who believe themselves to be evil, destructive invaders.

3-2.title: Morituri te Salutamus
3-2.overview: The duo choose to partake in gladiatorial combat against the Fight King's ghost warriors, but Finn succumbs to bloodlust while Jake becomes obsessed in keeping a cool morale.

3-3.title: Memory of a Memory
3-3.overview: Finn and Jake enter Marceline's mind to awaken her from a sleep spell she had cast on herself, without knowing that they are being tricked by a person from her past.

3-4.title: Hitman
3-4.overview: The grounded Ice King hires a fire-manipulating hitman to attack Finn and Jake, without realizing the potentially deadly consequences.

3-5.title: Too Young
3-5.overview: The Earl of Lemongrab takes over the Candy Kingdom due to Princess Bubblegum's age regression, forcing her and Finn to try and get rid of him even if it means a life-altering decision.

3-6.title: The Monster
3-6.overview: The king and queen of Lumpy Space ask Finn and Jake to bring their daughter back home. At the same time, they attempt to stop a "monster" from destroying a village.

3-7.title: Still
3-7.overview: Finn and Jake are literally unable to move and are at the mercy of the Ice King.

3-8.title: Wizard Battle
3-8.overview: Finn and Jake enter a competition for wizards in disguise so they can prevent Ice King from winning the grand prize: a kiss from Princess Bubblegum.

3-9.title: Fionna and Cake
3-9.overview: In this gender-swapped episode, Fionna and Cake must battle the evil Ice Queen.

3-10.title: What Was Missing
3-10.overview: Finn and his friends must come together as a genuine band in order to open the gate of the Door Lord and get back their taken items.

3-11.title: Apple Thief
3-11.overview: When Tree Trunks's apples go missing, she, Finn and Jake descend into the dark side of the Candy Kingdom in order to find the thief.

3-12.title: The Creeps
3-12.overview: Finn and Jake receive an invitation to a masquerade dinner. It turns into a whodunit as guests start to meet their demise.

3-13.title: From Bad to Worse
3-13.overview: When another plague of Candy Zombies arises and Princess Bubblegum is among the undead, Finn and his friends are in a race against time to figure out how to stop it...without making things even worse!

3-14.title: Beautopia
3-14.overview: Susan Strong asks Finn and Jake to help fight off the Glub Glubs in the sewers below to regain her people's home in Beautopia.

3-15.title: No One Can Hear You
3-15.overview: Finn awakens after an accident to find the Candy Kingdom citizens mysteriously gone and Jake acting crazier than usual.

3-16.title: Jake vs. Me-Mow
3-16.overview: Finn and Jake take on a request to protect Wildberry Princess from an unknown assassin. The assassin turns out to be a tiny cat assassin called Me-Mow, who ends up bribing Jake by poisoning him.

3-17.title: Thank You
3-17.overview: The Snow Golem visits the Fire Kingdom and finds an unlikely follower.

3-18.title: The New Frontier
3-18.overview: Jake dreams about his death, and Finn takes action when events from the dream start to come true.

3-19.title: Holly Jolly Secrets (1)
3-19.overview: Finn and Jake find the Ice King's video diary and have a chance to unearth his secrets.

3-20.title: Holly Jolly Secrets (2)
3-20.overview: The Ice King summons an army of snowmen to recover the secret tapes Finn and Jake are watching. They must work against the clock to find out the secrets enclosed within.

3-21.title: Marceline's Closet
3-21.overview: Finn and Jake play Cloud Hunt in Marceline's house, but they get trapped in her closet after she comes home.

3-22.title: Paper Pete
3-22.overview: Library books seek help from Finn and Jake to save them from the evil Moldari.

3-23.title: Another Way
3-23.overview: Cyclops tears may heal Finn and Jake's broken toes.

3-24.title: Ghost Princess
3-24.overview: Finn and Jake play detective and try to solve Ghost Princess' murder.

3-25.title: Dad's Dungeon
3-25.overview: Jake's dad presents a strange challenge to the guys when he appears to them in a holographic message, telling them about a dungeon he made for them.

3-26.title: Incendium
3-26.overview: Jake embarks on a solo mission to help a broken-hearted Finn.

4-1.title: Hot to the Touch
4-1.overview: Finn develops a crush on Flame Princess and tries to get to know her, which proves difficult due to her destructive power.

4-2.title: Five Short Graybles
4-2.overview: Follow as 5 stories intertwine together, can you find the connection?

4-3.title: Web Weirdos
4-3.overview: When Finn gets trapped in a giant spider web, he ends up playing marriage counselor to a couple of grumpy arachnids.

4-4.title: Dream of Love
4-4.overview: Tree Trunks is courted by an oinking suitor, but much to Jake’s dismay, this interferes with her baking habits.

4-5.title: Return to the Nightosphere
4-5.overview: Marceline’s dad banishes Finn and Jake to the Nightosphere, and it stinks. Literally.

4-6.title: Daddy's Little Monster
4-6.overview: Finn and Jake attempt to rescue Marceline and find out what's making her behave so strangely.

4-7.title: In Your Footsteps
4-7.overview: A bear cozies up to the guys, but his true intentions may be hidden.

4-8.title: Hug Wolf
4-8.overview: Finn goes through a transformation after a run-in with a hug wolf.

4-9.title: Princess Monster Wife
4-9.overview: Princesses lose body parts under mysterious circumstances.

4-10.title: Goliad
4-10.overview: Battling with her new realization of her own mortality, in a sleep deprived state Princess bubblegum creates her own heir to the throne. After meeting the heir, Finn and Jake decide to teach her the ways of the world.

4-11.title: Beyond This Earthly Realm
4-11.overview: When Finn finds a porcelain lamb, it transports him into the spirit world and only the Ice King can help get him out.

4-12.title: Gotcha!
4-12.overview: In order to do research for her tell-all memoir about men, Lumpy Space Princess goes undercover working for Finn and Jake.

4-13.title: Princess Cookie
4-13.overview: Finn and Jake are called to solve a Candy Kingdom hostage crisis when a rogue cookie takes over.

4-14.title: Card Wars
4-14.overview: Finn and Jake play Card Quest, an epic game.

4-15.title: Sons of Mars
4-15.overview:
Magic man has most of his power taken from him by his brother, in a fit of desperation, he swaps the way Jake and Himself look.

Magic Mans brother takes Jake to Mars for punishment,

4-16.title: Burning Low
4-16.overview: Princess Bubblegum may be jealous when Finn start hanging out with Flame Princess.

4-17.title: BMO Noire
4-17.overview: BMO tries to find Finn's sock.

4-18.title: King Worm
4-18.overview: Finn has a vivid dream that may be more than it seems.

4-19.title: Lady & Peebles
4-19.overview: Princess Bubblegum and Lady Rainicorn look for Finn and Jake, who are missing after a run-in with the Ice King.

4-20.title: You Made Me!
4-20.overview: When a creepy sleep-peeping Lemongrab upsets Princess Bubblegum with his creepy ways, Finn and Jake need to tend to some issues in the Outer Realm.

4-21.title: Who Would Win?
4-21.overview: The guys challenge a monster to a fight but end up battling each other.

4-22.title: Ignition Point
4-22.overview: Finn and Jake sneak into the Fire Kingdom to retrieve Fire Princess' scented candles and overhear a plot to assassinate the king.

4-23.title: The Hard Easy
4-23.overview: Frog People seek protection from an evil lizard who's attacking their swamp.

4-24.title: Reign of Gunters
4-24.overview: The Gunters cause chaos in Ooo.

4-25.title: I Remember You
4-25.overview: The Ice King and Marceline bond over song and memories.

4-26.title: The Lich
4-26.overview: A visit from the Lich King sheds light on Ooo's secrets.

5-1.title: Finn the Human
5-1.overview: Part 2 of a three-part episode. Finn and Jake chase the Lich through a dimensional portal and meet a wishmaster. After the Lich wishes that humanity never existed, Finn wishes that the Lich never existed.

5-2.title: Jake the Dog
5-2.overview: Part 3 of a three-part episode. Finn and Jake chase the Lich through a dimensional portal and meet a wishmaster. After the Lich wishes that humanity never existed, Finn wishes that the Lich never existed.

5-3.title: Five More Short Graybles
5-3.overview: A series of short stories all centered around a common theme, hosted by a mysterious man named Cuber from the future.

5-4.title: Up a Tree
5-4.overview: The guys' game of catch goes awry when their throwing disc is lodged in a large tree.

5-5.title: All the Little People
5-5.overview: Finn receives a bag full of miniature versions of his friends.

5-6.title: Jake the Dad
5-6.overview: Jake's a daddy, but being a father and keeping his rainicorn pups from killing themselves or each other is a lot harder than he imagined.

5-7.title: Davey
5-7.overview: Finn creates an alter ego, Davey. Davey soon begins to take over, and Jake is forced into action to get his old friend back.

5-8.title: Mystery Dungeon
5-8.overview: Ice King, NEPTR, Tree Trunks, Shelby, and Lemongrab are trapped inside a mysterious dungeon and must work together to free themselves.

5-9.title: All Your Fault
5-9.overview: Princess Bubblegum sends Finn and Jake to investigate a message of distress from the Earls of Lemongrab.

5-10.title: Little Dude
5-10.overview: Finn's hat comes to life and becomes evil after it is touched by a wizard. Finn, Jake, and the wizard track the hat down, and manage to turn the hat good.

5-11.title: Bad Little Boy
5-11.overview: The princesses tire of Ice King’s crazy Fionna-and-Cake fan-fiction stories, so Marceline stops by the Ice Kingdom to show him how to properly write a story.

5-12.title: Vault of Bones
5-12.overview: When Flame Princess begins to doubt her evilness, Finn insists she is not evil and takes her on a journey into a dungeon to help her sort out her thoughts.

5-13.title: The Great Bird Man
5-13.overview: Xergiok, the former Goblin king who was deposed by Finn and Jake claims to have turned over a new leaf.

5-14.title: Simon & Marcy
5-14.overview: A look at what Ice King and Marceline were like 996 years ago.

5-15.title: A Glitch Is a Glitch
5-15.overview: The Ice King creates a computer virus that will delete everyone in Ooo except for him and Princess Bubblegum. Finn and Jake hack into the universal source code to destroy the virus.

5-16.title: Puhoy
5-16.overview: While dwelling on a joke he told to Flame Princess, Finn finds himself trapped in a strange pillow world.

5-17.title: BMO Lost
5-17.overview: BMO makes his way home after being snatched by an eagle. On its way, BMO meets Bubble and a baby, and the three decide to journey home together.

5-18.title: Princess Potluck
5-18.overview: Ice King gets super jealous when he finds out that he wasn't invited to the Princess Potluck.

5-19.title: James Baxter the Horse
5-19.overview: Finn and Jake stumble across a horse named James Baxter who has the ability to make sad people feel better.

5-20.title: Shh!
5-20.overview: Finn and Jake make a bet to see who can not talk the longest, and the two use signs to communicate.

5-21.title: The Suitor
5-21.overview: Peppermint Butler thinks that Bubblegum is working too hard in her lab, so he tries to get her a suitor.

5-22.title: The Party's Over, Isla de Señorita
5-22.overview: After another one of his schemes fails, the Ice King decides to give up.

5-23.title: One Last Job
5-23.overview: Jake Jr. gets involved with a group of troublemakers, and Jake is forced to reunite his old gang—which includes Tiffany who first appeared in the first season episode "My Two Favorite People"—to rescue his daughter.

5-24.title: Another Five More Short Graybles
5-24.overview: A series of short stories with a common theme, hosted by a mysterious man named Cuber from the future. In this entry, Finn and Jake build a time machine. Meanwhile, Princess Bubblegum helps Cinnamon Bun overcome his fear of the dark.

5-25.title: Candy Streets
5-25.overview: Lumpy Space Princess is robbed, but before she is able to explain the details to Finn and Jake, she faints.

5-26.title: Wizards Only, Fools
5-26.overview: After Starchy comes down with a cold and needs a magic cure, Finn, Jake, and Princess Bubblegum disguise themselves as wizards and sneak into Wizard City.

5-27.title: Jake Suit
5-27.overview: Jake gets upset with the amount of times that Finn uses his body as a suit of armor, so he convinces Finn to trade places with him.

5-28.title: Be More
5-28.overview: BMO accidentally deletes his core system files. Finn and Jake disguise themselves as MOs to infiltrate the MO factory and save BMO from a memory wipe.

5-29.title: Sky Witch
5-29.overview: Marceline tracks the Sky Witch, but finds out that she may need Princess Bubblegum's help.

5-30.title: Frost & Fire
5-30.overview: Flame Princess and the Ice King fight each other, prompting Finn to have an interesting dream.

5-31.title: Too Old
5-31.overview: Finn, Jake and Princess Bubblegum discover a talented mutant named Lemonhope at The Pageant of Mutants. Now they must find a way to free him from the lemongrabs.

5-32.title: Earth & Water
5-32.overview: Princess Bubblegum subjects Flame Princess to a series of tests to gauge Flame Princess' fiery tendencies. But when there's an emergency at the treehouse, and Princess Bubblegum leaves Cinnamon Bun to watch Flame Princess, her experiment might literally backfire in her face.

5-33.title: Time Sandwich
5-33.overview: Jake crafts the most delicious sandwich ever, but when Magic Man steals it, Finn must defy the laws of space and time to win back Jake's creation.

5-34.title: The Vault
5-34.overview: When Finn starts sleepwalking and dreaming about the Green Lady he filed away in his memory vault, Jake and BMO help him tap into his repressed memories to uncover a secret past. Who is the Green Lady? And how is she connected to Finn?

5-35.title: Love Games
5-35.overview: Slime Princess needs a husband or else she'll lose the Slime Kingdom to her obnoxious sis. Finn steps in to save the day, but first they will need to win a series of Love Games to prove to Slime Princess's dad that they are really in love. This is definitely not what Finn signed up for!

5-36.title: Dungeon Train
5-36.overview: All aboard! Finn and Jake discover a train where every car is a dungeon filled with a new foe for Finn to fight. Jake quickly gets bored and wants to leave, but Finn is having the best time and doesn't want to leave... ever!

5-37.title: Box Prince
5-37.overview: Finn meets the Box Prince—a cat with a box on its back—and learns that the Box Kingdom has been taken over by an imposter. Finn must therefore help the real Box Prince reclaim the throne.

5-38.title: Red Starved
5-38.overview: Finn, Jake and Marceline are trapped in an underground cavern with no red in sight. If Marceline doesn't feed, like ASAP, she will turn into a vampiric beast and suck out all of Jake's blood! So, Finn heads off to explore the cave and find something red to satiate her until they can be rescued. But time is running out!

5-39.title: We Fixed a Truck
5-39.overview: Finn finds an old truck, and Jake calls Banana Man to help with the repairs. But when BMO stays up all night working on the truck, he hears on a spooky radio talk show that Princess Bubblegum is a reptilian replicant. Is it just another one of Starchy's crazy conspiracy theories, or a fact?

5-40.title: Play Date
5-40.overview: Sick and tired of babysitting Ice King while the Ice Kingdom is being rebuilt, Finn and Jake call up an old friend to hang out with their annoying houseguest: Abracadaniel.

5-41.title: The Pit
5-41.overview: Finn needs Lady Rainicorn's help to rescue Jake when he is kidnapped by Kee-Oth the Blood Demon.

5-42.title: James
5-42.overview: Finn, Jake, and Princess Bubblegum are attacked by nasty goo monsters in the Desert of Wonders.

5-43.title: Root Beer Guy
5-43.overview: Root Beer Guy works a boring job during the day and tries to write mystery stories at night. But his life is about to change when he witnesses Finn and Jake kidnapping Princess Bubblegum! There's only one problem: no one believes Root Beer Guy...

5-44.title: Apple Wedding
5-44.overview: Tree Trunks and Mr. Pig are celebrating the wedding of the year.

5-45.title: Blade of Grass
5-45.overview: Finn and Jake decide it's time for Finn to get a new sword. Finn reluctantly buys a grass sword from a mysterious old man, but the sword turns out to be cursed! And unfortunately for our hero, all sales are final.

5-46.title: Rattleballs
5-46.overview: Finn practices his sword fighting skills at the candy junkyard, where he meets an old gumball robot named Rattleballs. To Finn's shock, he finds out he's not the master swordsman he thinks he is. What the what?! Finn begs Rattleballs to train him, but he soon discovers his mentor's deep, dark secret... a secret that will ultimately test Finn's loyalty to Princess Bubblegum.

5-47.title: The Red Throne
5-47.overview: When Flame King breaks out of his prison and takes over the Flame Kingdom again, Flame Princess turns to the one person she believes she can trust... Finn! But will Finn be able to put his feelings for Flame Princess aside long enough to help her reclaim her throne?

5-48.title: Betty
5-48.overview: After a magic spell backfires, the Ice King reverts back to Simon, and seeks help from Finn, Jake, and Marceline in order to get Betty, his former fiancée, back.

5-49.title: Bad Timing
5-49.overview: Love is in the air when Lumpy Space Princess reconnects with an old classmate, but will her jealousy get in the way of finding true love?

5-50.title: Lemonhope (1)
5-50.overview: Tired of all of Princess Bubblegum's talk about "responsibility," Lemonhope yearns for true freedom. So he sets off on the greatest adventure of his lemony life.

5-51.title: Lemonhope (2)
5-51.overview: Though Lemonhope finds refuge from the desert with monster hunter Phlannel Boxingday, he might not be able to escape the ghosts of his past.

5-52.title: Billy's Bucket List
5-52.overview: Finn finds the hero Billy's bucket list and decides to complete the unfinished items as a final tribute.

267440.name: Attack on Titan
267440.overview: 100 years ago, the last remnants of humanity were forced to retreat behind the towering walls of a fortified city to escape the massive, man-eating Titans that roamed the land outside their fortress. Only the members of the Scouting Legion dared to stray beyond the safety of the walls – but even those brave warriors seldom returned alive. Those within the city clung to the illusion of a peaceful existence until the day that dream was shattered, and their slim chance at survival was reduced to one horrifying choice: kill – or be devoured!

0-1.title: Since That Day
0-1.overview: A recap of events since the Fall of Shiganshina and the Battle of Trost.

0-2.title: Chibi Theater: Fly, Cadets, Fly!: Day 1 / Day 2
0-2.overview: Eren has trouble getting to school on time, before he and Armin find themselves in the nurse's office.

0-3.title: Chibi Theater: Fly, Cadets, Fly!: Day 3 / Day 4
0-3.overview: Eren tries to make a strong impression before his instructor, whilst Jean becomes jealous of Eren's closeness with Mikasa.

0-4.title: Chibi Theater: Fly, Cadets, Fly!: Day 5 / Day 6 / Day 7
0-4.overview: Sasha is accused of crime she din't commit, whilst Armin finds a rather dubious book.  Later, Eren and Mikasa try to learn about the Titan's weakness.

0-5.title: Chibi Theater: Fly, Cadets, Fly!: Day 8 / Day 9 / Day 10
0-5.overview: Eren accidentally stumbles into the classroom as the girls were taking off their clothes, Mikasa competes against Ymir for Eren's pudding, Krista and Ymir discuss who they should spend the day with.

0-6.title: Chibi Theater: Fly, Cadets, Fly!: Day 11 / Day 12 / Day 13
0-6.overview: Eren attempts to improve his body by following Reiner's every move, Bertholdt tries to improve his confidence, Mikasa and Annie compete to see who can inflict more pain on Eren.

0-7.title: Ilse's Notebook: Memoirs of a Recon Corps Member
0-7.overview: Hange is insistent on capturing a Titan for the advancement of scientific research, but Erwin is adamant in his refusal to allow it. Will an unexpected discovery during an expedition beyond the walls alter the situation?

0-8.title: Chibi Theater: Fly, Cadets, Fly!: Day 14 / Day 15 / Day 16
0-8.overview: Conny and Sasha attempt to prank Shadis, Eren decides to shave his hair, Armin tutors Eren, Sasha, and Conny when they failed their test.

0-9.title: Chibi Theater: Fly, Cadets, Fly!: Day 17 / Day 18 / Day 19
0-9.overview: Eren struggles to balance himself on the omni-directional mobility gear, Jean gets lost during training, Marco sneaks into the Girl's Dormitory to return a lost pink bag.

0-10.title: Chibi Theater: Fly, Cadets, Fly!: Day 20 / Day 21 / Day 22
0-10.overview: Franz and Hannah try to help Eren reconcile with Mikasa after an argument, Mikasa tries to act on her feelings with Eren, and Hange tries to communicate with a Titan.

0-11.title: Reading & Live Event
0-11.overview: A live reading event by seiyuu of Attack on Titan.

0-12.title: Chibi Theater: Fly, Cadets, Fly!: Day 23 / Day 24 / Day 25
0-12.overview: Erwin tries to change his appearance to appeal to cadets, Levi analyzes himself from another's point of view, and the graduation ceremony of the 104th Cadet Corps takes place.

0-13.title: The Sudden Visitor: The Torturous Curse of Youth
0-13.overview: Two years after escaping the torment of his mother, Jean attempts to avoid her when returning to Trost for a training exercise. In a strange turn of events, he ends up in a cooking contest against Sasha.

0-14.title: Distress
0-14.overview: What begins as a simple training exercise turns into a disaster. A dysfunctional team of cadets must learn to work together after Christa is taken hostage by a group of brigands.

0-15.title: A Choice with No Regrets (1)
0-15.overview: Levi and his crew steal from merchants to scrape by in the dreary Underground. They're approached by a man from the surface with a job that could change their lives for the better.

0-16.title: A Choice with No Regrets (2)
0-16.overview: Levi's group joins the Scout Regiment, but they bring with them a hidden agenda. The upcoming expedition beyond the walls seems like the perfect opportunity to carry out their plan.

0-17.title: Lost Girls: Wall Sina, Goodbye (1)
0-17.overview: When Annie needs a day off from patrol duty to take care of some personal business, her roommate agrees to cover for her. But only if she does her the favor of searching for a girl who's been reported missing.

0-18.title: Lost Girls: Wall Sina, Goodbye (2)
0-18.overview: After discovering the body of Carly's lover, Annie plans the next steps of her search. However, her snooping lands her in trouble and she'll need to think quickly if she hopes to survive.

0-19.title: Lost Girls: Lost in the Cruel World
0-19.overview: Mikasa reflects on when she was lost in a world of her own making. Inside this world, everything went her way except for the one thing she wanted to change most.

0-20.title: Chibi Theater: Fly, New Levi Squad, Fly!: Day 38 / Day 39 / Day 40

0-21.title: Chibi Theater: Fly, New Levi Squad, Fly!: Day 41 / Day 42 / Day 43

0-22.title: Chibi Theater: Fly, New Levi Squad, Fly!: Day 44 / Day 45 / Day 46
