1-1167.overview: 17 years ago, Kuroda helped Asaka escape. Now, Rum sets his sights on a new target tied to the past.

1-1168.title: Genta's Casebook of the Eel
1-1168.overview: While Genta delivers food for an eel restaurant, the chef is stabbed in the chest.

1-1169.title: The Mystery of the Man-Eating Classroom (1)
1-1169.overview: A rumor begins spreading at Teitan Elementary School about a man-eating classroom.

1-1170.title: The Mystery of the Man-Eating Classroom (2)
1-1170.overview: Conan identifies the culprit who started the fire that could cancel the class visit.

1-1171.title: The Reason He Became a Butler (1)
1-1171.overview: Heiji and Kazuha happen to find themselves on the same bullet train bound for Tokyo as Momiji and Iori.

1-1172.title: The Reason He Became a Butler (2)
1-1172.overview: Momiji's butler Iori becomes involved in a murder on a train, and Momiji is taken hostage.

1-1173.title: It's a Ghost!
1-1173.overview: The Detective Boys investigate a ghost that appears on the roof of a building every Thursday night.

1-1174.title: The Glassy Water's Surface (1)
1-1174.overview: Kogoro is hired to investigate the mysterious death of a fisherman in a small town famous for its boathouses.

1-1175.title: The Glassy Water's Surface (2)
1-1175.overview: One mysterious murder turns into two in a remote port town in Kyoto prefecture.

1-1176.title: The Hero of Ishinomaki
1-1176.overview: The Detective Boys go to Miyagi Prefecture to film an episode of Kamen Yaiba.

1-1177.title: Find the Phantom Giant
1-1177.overview: The Detective Boys encounter Takagi and Chiba, who are looking for a tall man to verify a suspect's alibi.

1-1178.title: The Crimson Skeleton of Mt. Washio (1)
1-1178.overview: A sudden downpour forces Conan and his friends to seek shelter at a temple.

1-1179.title: The Crimson Skeleton of Mt. Washio (2)
1-1179.overview: The missing monk turns up dead, but Kogoro is still missing. Could it be the curse of the Crimson Skeleton?

1-1180.title: The Lucky Cat Saw Everything
1-1180.overview: While birdwatching, Conan, Ran, and Kogoro spot a suspicious man driving away from house with a body inside.

1-1181.title: Buchi Returns a Favor
1-1181.overview: A man identifying himself as Buchi calls the police station with information for Detective Takagi.

1-1182.title: Arrest That Face
1-1182.overview: Ayumi sees a man with a face identical to one on a wanted poster.

1-1183.title: The Interrogation Room 3
1-1183.overview: A rising young actress admits to murdering her director but later recants her confession.

1-1184.title: The Red-Brick Warehouse and the Vanishing Kidnapper (1)
1-1184.overview: Detectives Takagi and Sato pursue a kidnapper to the historic red-brick warehouse in Yokohama.

1-1185.title: The Red-Brick Warehouse and the Vanishing Kidnapper (2)
1-1185.overview: The kids decipher the Dice Man's code while the police pursue the culprit at the red-brick warehouse.

1-1186.title: Girls Day Mystery 4
1-1186.overview: The ladies meet at an all-you-can-eat cake buffet, and the women at a nearby table suddenly collapse.

1-1187.title: Episode "ZERO" Kudo Shinichi and the Aquarium Case
1-1187.overview: Before he became Conan, Shinichi and Ran's trip to the aquarium is derailed by a murder.

1-1188.title: Follow Them! Detective Taxi 3
1-1188.overview: Kogoro and Conan are invited to attend an event in Furai City as special guests.

1-1189.title: Double Alibi
1-1189.overview: Kogoro is hired by an up-and-coming clockmaker to investigate a threatening note.

1-1190.title: The Lover Who Vanished on Pont Koitani (Tottori Tour)
1-1190.overview: A waitress disappears from the ryokan where Conan, Ran, and Kogoro are staying at the Misasa Hot Springs.

1-1191.title: The Lover Who Vanished on Pont Koitani (Misasa Arc)
1-1191.overview: The missing lover's fake disappearance turns into a real kidnapping.

1-1192.title: Tsuburaya Mitsuhiko's Detective Notes 4
1-1192.overview: The Detective Boys come across a case reminiscent of "The Adventure of the Abbey Grange".

1-1193.title: Kid VS Hakuba: The Azure Throne (1)
1-1193.overview: Kaito Kid sneaks into the exhibition room to steal the Azure Throne only to discover a body sitting in it.

1-1194.title: Kid VS Hakuba: The Azure Throne (2)
1-1194.overview: Hakuba, the disguised Kid, and Conan expose the murderer. But Hakuba harbors yet another suspicion…

1-1195.title: The Spiral Mansion Mystery (1)
1-1195.overview: A man is found dead at an art museum dedicated to spirals.

1-1196.title: The Spiral Mansion Mystery (2)
1-1196.overview: A vanishing culprit, a secret room, and a second murder. Conan closes in on the center of the mystery.

1-1197.title: The Cosplay Rider of the Wind
1-1197.overview: The Detective Boys and a Kamen Yaiba impostor chase a serial purse snatcher on a motorcycle.

1-1198.title: Cinderalla's Shoe
1-1198.overview: Kogoro is hired to find the Cinderella of the son of a business conglomerate.

1-1199.title: The Detective Boys VS the Silver Detectives 2
1-1199.overview: A woman asks a group of senior detectives to find her missing husband.

1-1200.title: The Porch Pirate Epidemic
1-1200.overview: Kogoro is hired to catch a porch pirate.

1-1201.title: I'm the Culprit
1-1201.overview: Four people confess to committing the same murder, but none of them will explain how they did it.

1-1202.title: I Cannot Lie to Archery
1-1202.overview: Two brothers are suspected of murdering their father with a bow and arrow.

1-1203.title: Sonoko and Conan's Ghost Story Night
1-1203.overview: While staying at a mountain lodge, Conan and Sonoko stumble upon a masked figure burying a body. As the mysterious culprit gives chase, the two must find a way to escape.

1-1204.title: Who Kidnapped Conan and Azusa? (1)
1-1204.overview: Conan and Azusa ask Amuro for help after realizing they are being followed. But when a passing bus blocks the view, the two suddenly disappear.

1-1205.title: Who Kidnapped Conan and Azusa? (2)
1-1205.overview: As the kidnapping of Conan and Azusa continues, clues at their hideout point to a connection with a shocking serial crime. Can Amuro and the high school girl trio uncover the culprit before it's too late?

1-1206.title: The Man Who Came Falling Down

393810.name: Record of Ragnarok
393810.overview: Before eradicating humankind from the world, the gods give them one last chance to prove themselves worthy of survival. Let the Ragnarok battles begin.

similar.name: Fate/Grand Order Absolute Demonic Front: Babylonia
The Idaten Deities Know Only Peace

1-1.title: Ragnarok
1-1.overview: At the Council of Valhalla, the gods vote unanimously for humankind's extinction. But Brunhilde, eldest of the Valkyrie sisters, raises her objection.

1-2.title: Worthy Opponent
1-2.overview: In the first round of the Ragnarok battle, Han dynasty warlord Lü Bu puts up a good fight against Norse god Thor, surprising the gods in attendance.

1-3.title: Killer Move
1-3.overview: To give Lü Bu the upper hand against Thor, Brünnhilde summons her sister Randgriz and asks her to transform into a sacred weapon — the Shield Breaker.

1-4.title: Joy
1-4.overview: Lü Bu's legs are crushed by the mighty Geirröd Thor's Hammer attack, but just when all hope seems lost, the warlord's trusty horse Red Hare rides in.

1-5.title: FILE No.00000000001
1-5.overview: Chosen for the next round is the father of humankind and the man bearing more hatred towards the gods than anyone else: Adam himself.

1-6.title: Great Emulation
1-6.overview: Zeus insists on going up against Adam, who joins forces with Valkyrie Reginleif to obtain a most peculiar weapon: a knuckleduster.

1-7.title: Expelled from Paradise
1-7.overview: Just when it looks like Adam will earn humankind the victory they long for, Zeus gathers his strength to ask Adam why he's really fighting.

1-8.title: Grace Abounding
1-8.overview: Zeus has transformed into his final most powerful form, but after the beating he's suffered, he may not last much longer in the fight.

1-9.title: Tyrant of the Ocean
1-9.overview: Humankind is desperate to win the next bout, but the god they're going up against is one of the mightiest of them all: Poseidon.

1-10.title: Greatest Loser
1-10.overview: Kojiro Sasaki uses his mighty Tsubame Gaeshi move to finish off Poseidon, but the god of the sea won't be sunk so easily.

1-11.title: The Swallow Gazes into the Abyss
1-11.overview: Through the power of Valkyrie Hrist, Kojiro's broken blade is transformed into dual swords, allowing him to tap into the depths of his inner strength.

1-12.title: And Ragnarok Goes On
1-12.overview: Despite Kojiro's Niten Ganryu duel blade method, Poseidon's powerful attacks continue to wear him down. But the battle isn't over yet.

2-1.title: Good vs. Evil
2-1.overview: The gods have no intention of letting the humans win the next round; for their next fighter, they present none other than the great hero, Hercules.

2-2.title: The Indomitable War God
2-2.overview: The spectators notice that the tattoos on Hercules have grown significantly — and if they continue to grow, the hero will suffer a painful death.

2-3.title: Birth of a Monster
2-3.overview: In late 19th century London, the young son of a prostitute has a special ability that helps him survive the poverty he was born into.

2-4.title: The Final Labor
2-4.overview: Although he’s lost his left arm, Hercules remains steadfast, easily summoning the strength to unleash his ultimate move: the Twelfth Labor.

2-5.title: Requiem
2-5.overview: The brutal fourth round has pushed both fighters beyond their breaking point; when the winner is finally announced, there is no joy or celebration.

2-6.title: Conflicting Motives
2-6.overview: To capitalize on humanity's momentum, Brünnhilde pays a visit to the colossal Tameemon Raiden, the most powerful sumo wrestler in history.

2-7.title: Hundred Seals
2-7.overview: Stepping into the sumo ring to take on Tameemon Raiden is the God of Destruction, the Destroyer himself: Supreme Lord Shiva.

2-8.title: The Pinnacle of 1116
2-8.overview: Years ago, Shiva spent many happy days with his best friend Rudra. Then one day, Rudra asks Shiva to join him on a journey to the top.

2-9.title: Resonance
2-9.overview: As a child, Raiden had to suppress his full strength so he wouldn’t hurt other people. But now, to win this battle, he’s not holding anything back.

2-10.title: The Brink
2-10.overview: The match comes to a moving end. Even Zeus is impressed by humanity's powerful spirit; but he's going to make sure the gods get the ultimate victory.

2-11.title: Round Six
2-11.overview: With the scoreboard almost neck-and-neck, Buddha declares that he'll fight in the next round — but whose side will he be fighting on?

2-12.title: Zero
2-12.overview: Struck by the amount of suffering humans must endure, Zerofuku decides to absorb all of their unhappiness, but it still isn't enough to end their pain.

2-13.title: The strongest puberty in history
2-13.overview: There was once a prince who was born into great wealth and given the very best of everything. But one day, he decides to leave it all behind.

2-14.title: Legend of the Underworld
2-14.overview: Nobody knows who the strange new creature is, but he's clearly very strong. And most worryingly, Buddha can't foresee his new opponent's next moves.

2-15.title: The Way of Light
2-15.overview: It looks like the match is over. But then Buddha gets up, looking stronger than ever. Will he be able to gain another crucial point for the humans?

3-1.title: Prologue: Recollections
3-1.overview: While humanity celebrates, the sixth round's result rattles the gods. Brunhilde and Hermes reflect on the previous battles and humanity's resilience.

3-2.title: King vs. King
3-2.overview: With the gods desperate for a win, Hades steps up to avenge his brother. Humanity sends Qin Shi Huang, setting the stage for a monumental clash of kings.

3-3.title: Chi You
3-3.overview: After uniting China, Qin Shi Huang ascends Mount Tai alone to prove himself before the demon god Chi You. There, he masters the ultimate martial art.

3-4.title: A Promise and an Oath
3-4.overview: As a child, Qin Shi Huang's daily life is filled with hostility. Yet over time, he finds happiness in the close bond he forms with his strict caretaker.

3-5.title: Pride of the King of Helheim
3-5.overview: As the seventh round heats up, Hades gouges his own chest, humming as blood pours out and empowers his divine weapon with new strength.

3-6.title: Return of the King
3-6.overview: On the brink of death, Qin Shi Huang draws strength from Alvitr, unleashing the Force of the Phoenix again. Hades readies his spear for the final blow.

3-7.title: Satan
3-7.overview: For the eighth round, the gods choose Beelzebub, the god cursed by Satan. Though shunned by all, he once had three close friends who shaped his destiny.

3-8.title: Light vs. Shadow
3-8.overview: While struggling with Beelzebub's vibration-based powers, Tesla recognizes them as a form of science and counters with the full force of human ingenuity.

3-9.title: A Curse and a Prayer
3-9.overview: Tesla traps Beelzebub in the Gematria Zone and unleashes the Tesla Step, but Beelzebub learns to nullify the onslaught. The gods expect victory, but...

3-10.title: The Torch Passed On
3-10.overview: Even after Beelzebub unleashes Helheim's forbidden technique, Tesla stands firm. As the battle peaks, he recalls childhood memories of his brother.

3-11.title: Progress
3-11.overview: Though battered, Tesla is relentless, pushing Beelzebub on the defensive and to his limits. The showdown between science versus myth reaches its climax.

3-12.title: The Sun God and the Rebellious Hero
3-12.overview: The gods' next fighter is Apollo, the radiant sun god. Representing humanity is King Leonidas of Sparta. As round nine begins, neither will back down.

3-13.title: Pride vs. Pride
3-13.overview: In the past, King Leonidas of Sparta defies Apollo's prophecies and goes to war. Now, with his pride on the line, he delivers a decisive strike at Apollo.

3-14.title: Know Thyself
3-14.overview: Fueled by unyielding resolve, Leonidas slams Apollo down. As the bloodied god rises, most gods scorn his pride, but Zeus and Ares see the truth.

3-15.title: A Clash of Souls
3-15.overview: Both fighters near death but stand tall, honoring each other's valor. Leonidas transforms his shield and advances as Apollo draws his mythical bow.

247982.name: Madan Senki Ryukendo
247982.overview: Akebono City is a peaceful community overflowing with humanity. Since there was a Power Spot that released the magical power in the community, the people were distressed by the threat of the demon army Jamanga who are gathering Minus Energy from the frightened masses for a sinister purpose. The secret organization S.H.O.T. was formed to protect the people of the community from the Jamanga, concealing their existence as ordinary members of the Akebono Police Station, which considers demons beyond their jurisdiction. Kenji Narukami, a student of the Narukami Dragon God Style for fighting demons, arrives at Akebono to fight the demons, eventually getting his wish when he is transformed to RyuKenDo and faces off against Jamanga's forces together with his friends to restore peace in the community.

similar.name: Record of Lodoss War: Chronicles of the Heroic Knight

251085.name: The Legend of Korra
251085.overview: Avatar Korra, a headstrong, rebellious, feisty young woman who continually challenges and breaks with tradition, is on her quest to become a fully realized Avatar. In this story, the Avatar struggles to find balance within herself.

similar.name: She-Ra and the Princesses of Power
Batman: The Brave and the Bold

1-1.title: Welcome to Republic City
1-1.overview: Korra, the new Avatar, travels to Republic city to start her Airbending training.

1-2.title: A Leaf in the Wind
1-2.overview: Against Tenzin's prohibition, a frustrated Korra sneaks out to visit the pro-bending sports arena.

1-3.title: The Revelation
1-3.overview: Korra attempts to infiltrate the Equalist movement and learn more about its mysterious leader.

1-4.title: The Voice in the Night
1-4.overview: Korra becomes part of Councilman Tarrlok's task force which aims to rid Republic City of the Equalists.

1-5.title: The Spirit of Competition
1-5.overview: As Asami steals Mako's heart, Korra struggles to express her feelings for Mako and also at the same time Bolin tries to win Korra's heart by being brave enough to ask Korra to go out with him. The tension gets higher as the Pro bending tournament starts.

1-6.title: And the Winner Is...
1-6.overview: Korra and the Fire Ferrets are in the pro-bending championship, but will the Equalists allow the game to go on?

1-7.title: The Aftermath
1-7.overview: Korra suspects that an ally is working with the Equalists.

1-8.title: When Extremes Meet
1-8.overview: Korra faces off with Councilman Tarrlok as Equalist activity continues to rise in Republic City.

1-9.title: Out of the Past
1-9.overview: After being imprisoned by Tarrlok, Korra attempts to analyze the mysterious visions she has been having. Meanwhile, Tenzin, Lin, Mako, Bolin and Asami search for Korra, having been given false information by Tarrlok.

1-10.title: Turning the Tides
1-10.overview: The Equalists begin their attack on Republic City.

1-11.title: Skeletons in the Closet
1-11.overview: Korra goes undercover as the war between benders and non-benders intensifies.

1-12.title: Endgame
1-12.overview: The duel between Amon and Korra - will Korra be powerful enough to beat Amon?

2-1.title: Rebel Spirit
2-1.overview: Korra struggles to find a deeper connection with the Spirit World as she and the gang attend a Southern Water Tribe festival.

2-2.title: The Southern Lights
2-2.overview: Korra and Chief Unalaq journey into a dangerous maelstrom and find a source of great spiritual power.

2-3.title: Civil Wars (1)
2-3.overview: While tensions flare between the Northern and Southern Water Tribes, Korra struggles to remain neutral.

2-4.title: Civil Wars (2)
2-4.overview: When Korra's parents are wrongfully arrested, Korra fights for their freedom.

2-5.title: Peacekeepers
2-5.overview: When the President of the United Republic refuses to help Korra, she decides to take matters into her own hands.

2-6.title: The Sting
2-6.overview: When Triad activity threatens to put Future Industries out of business, Mako performs an investigation and discovers a much bigger conspiracy.

2-7.title: Beginnings (1)
2-7.overview: Korra learns about the epic and mythic origins of the first Avatar.

2-8.title: Beginnings (2)
2-8.overview: Korra delves deeper into the Avatar's past and realizes what she must do in order to restore balance between the physical and spirit worlds.

2-9.title: The Guide
2-9.overview: Korra seeks Tenzin's help to enter the Spirit World for the first time.

2-10.title: A New Spiritual Age
2-10.overview: Korra enters the Spirit World and struggles with the Avatar's relationship with the spirits.

2-11.title: Night of a Thousand Stars
2-11.overview: When President Raiko is attacked, Bolin saves the day.

2-12.title: Harmonic Convergence
2-12.overview: Korra and company attempt to close the spirit portals before Harmonic Convergence.

2-13.title: Darkness Falls
2-13.overview: Korra discovers a new twist in Unalaq's evil plan. Meanwhile, Tenzin realizes he must face his own demons in order to save his daughter.

2-14.title: Light in the Dark
2-14.overview: Korra discovers a way she may be able to defeat the ultimate dark spirit and save the world.

3-1.title: A Breath of Fresh Air
3-1.overview: After the events of Harmonic Convergence, Korra has her hands full with trying to remove all the spirit vines that have overgrown Republic City. Her lack of success strains her relationship with President Raiko and brings down her approval rate among the city's populace. When airbenders are suddenly popping up across the world and causing more trouble for the city, President Raiko demands Korra to leave the city, which she takes as an opportunity to travel the world to find the new airbenders. Meanwhile, a dangerous criminal uses his newfound airbending abilities to escape.

3-2.title: Rebirth
3-2.overview: Tenzin, Jinora, and Team Avatar travel toward Ba Sing Se in order to find the new airbenders. Stopping at various villages along the way, they hope to recruit them in order to rebuild the Air Nation, though with little success as they were only able to convince a young boy named Kai to join them. Meanwhile, Zaheer travels the four nations to free his fellow criminals from their prison. After freeing Ghazan and Ming-Hua, they set course for the Northern Water Tribe to free their last member, P'Li. Upon learning of their escape, Lord Zuko sets course for the Northern Water Tribe himself in an attempt to stop them.

3-3.title: The Earth Queen
3-3.overview: Team Avatar arrives in Ba Sing Se. While Korra has an audience with the Earth Queen, the others notice that Kai has gone missing, prompting Mako and Bolin to go look for him. They track him down, but he manages to shake them in the monorail, which takes the brothers to the Lower Ring, where they eventually run into their family from their father's side. Meanwhile, Korra and Asami set course for a small village to collect taxes as a favor to the Queen. After getting her money, the Queen brushes off Korra's request for help in tracking down the airbenders, leaving the Avatar to storm out of the palace. In the city, Kai found himself arrested by the Dai Li and subsequently conscripted in the Earth Queen's first airbending regiment.

3-4.title: In Harm's Way
3-4.overview: Lord Zuko, Tonraq, Desna, and Eska try to prevent Zaheer from freeing the last prisoner, P'Li, while Korra discovers that the Earth Queen is forcing all the airbenders in Ba Sing Se to join her army. Team Avatar thus devises a plan to free them from the monarch's captivity.

3-5.title: The Metal Clan
3-5.overview: Korra's quest leads her and her friends to the metal city of Zaofu.

3-6.title: Old Wounds
3-6.overview: Per Su's suggestion, Korra begins to learn metalbending. Opal admits her reluctance to leave Zaofu due to her obligations to her family while Bolin deals with his fear of learning how to bend metal. Meanwhile, Lin faces her past during an acupuncture sessions, forcing her to relive the circumstances which led to her and Su's strained relationship. After a cathartic release of her repressed emotions, Lin makes amends with her sister as well as Opal, who she convinces to travel to the Northern Air Temple to train with Tenzin. Elsewhere, Zaheer and his group determine Korra's whereabouts shortly after escaping Republic City, deducing that she was under the Metal Clan's protection in Zaofu.

3-7.title: Original Airbenders
3-7.overview: Despite Bumi's bad attitude, Tenzin attempts to train the new members of the Air Nation with little success. Things become more complicated for the airbending master as Jinora, with Kai's influence, begins to exert her independence and demand her airbending tattoos. The new airbenders are tested when they are forced to face a group of bison rustlers who have taken Jinora and Kai along with several bison calves.

3-8.title: The Terror Within
3-8.overview: Zaheer and his gang try to kidnap Korra.

3-9.title: The Stakeout
3-9.overview: Korra learns the truth about the group that is planning to destroy her.

3-10.title: Long Live the Queen
3-10.overview: Korra and Asami are stranded in the desert. The members of The Red Lotus negotiate with the Earth Queen.

3-11.title: The Ultimatum
3-11.overview: Mako and Bolin deliver an ominous message from Zaheer.

3-12.title: Enter the Void
3-12.overview: When other plans fail, Korra suggests a brave idea to take on the Red Lotus and save the Air Nation.

3-13.title: Venom of the Red Lotus
3-13.overview: Korra battles Zaheer, while Bolin and Mako duel Ghazan and Ming-Hua. The captive members of the Air Nation escape and band together to help Korra.

4-1.title: After All These Years
4-1.overview: It's been three years since Zaheer poisoned Korra and the members of Team Avatar have moved on with their lives; Kai and Opal help a struggling Earth Kingdom town.

4-2.title: Korra Alone
4-2.overview: Korra's three-year journey of healing takes her to unexpected places.

4-3.title: The Coronation
4-3.overview: Prince Wu's big day is ruined by Kuvira; Korra thinks she may have found the key to a full recovery.

4-4.title: The Calling
4-4.overview: While the young airbenders look far and wide for Korra, Ikki is briefly captured by two Earth Empire soldiers. Based on what they say, Ikki leads the trio to the swamp. There, Korra is still haunted by visions of being hurt by her past enemies, but manages to connect to the siblings through the great banyan-grove tree's roots. After they beg her to resume her Avatar duties to face Kuvira, Toph's advice helps Korra to let go of her fears, bend the rest of the poison out of herself and re-enter the Avatar State.

4-5.title: Enemy at the Gates
4-5.overview: Kuvira threatens Zaofu; Bolin is caught in the middle of the bad blood between Su Beifong and Kuvira.

4-6.title: The Battle of Zaofu
4-6.overview: Korra returns to her role as the Avatar, but is she really ready for action? Bolin and Varrick break from Kuvira's army.

4-7.title: Reunion
4-7.overview: Korra returns to Republic City and Team Avatar faces their first mission together in three years when Prince Wu goes missing; Bolin and Varrick are on the lam.

4-8.title: Remembrances
4-8.overview: In a clip show episode, Mako, Korra, and Bolin recollect their past. Mako tells Wu about his romantic entanglements and eventual breakup with Asami and Korra. Korra talks to Asami about her confrontations with Amon, Unalaq, Vaatu, and Zaheer. Varrick presents Bolin's life to the Earth Empire refugees in the style of an action film in which Bolin defeats all of Korra's previous enemies.

4-9.title: Beyond the Wilds
4-9.overview: The spirit vines in Republic City start abducting people and it's up to Korra to figure out why.

4-10.title: Operation Beifong
4-10.overview: Bolin helps Opal and Lin save the Beifongs from Kuvira. Korra visits the Spirit World looking for help.

4-11.title: Kuvira's Gambit
4-11.overview: Korra and Team Avatar try to stop Kuvira from moving against Republic City; Kuvira unveils a deadly new weapon.

4-12.title: Day of the Colossus
4-12.overview: Team Avatar clashes with Kuvira on the streets of Republic City; Pema and Prince Wu help evacuate innocent citizens.

4-13.title: The Last Stand
4-13.overview: The fate of the Earth Kingdom and the Avatar's life is at stake, when Korra comes face to face with Kuvira.

329065.name: Castlevania
329065.overview: A vampire hunter fights to save a besieged city from an army of otherworldly beasts controlled by Dracula himself.

1-1.title: Witchbottle
1-1.overview: A headstrong young woman seeks out forbidden knowledge, and a corrupt bishop courts disaster by enraging a legend.

1-2.title: Necropolis
1-2.overview: Trevor Belmont drifts into the panicked city of Gresit, where he learns of an ancient evil and makes a surprising vow.

1-3.title: Labyrinth
1-3.overview: Belmont explores the catacombs of Gresit and makes a disturbing discovery. As night falls on the city, the beasts return for blood.

1-4.title: Monument
1-4.overview: Belmont strives to save Gresit from certain doom and comes face to face with a shocking truth.

2-1.title: War Council
2-1.overview: Dracula entrusts a deadly -- and personal -- mission with two humans who truly hate humanity, not knowing that he himself has become a target.

2-2.title: Old Homes
2-2.overview: As Belmont shares a bold strategy with Alucard and Sypha, Dracula addresses a conflict within his ranks. Isaac recalls a painful encounter.

2-3.title: Shadow Battles
2-3.overview: Belmont travels to his family's archives, along with Sypha and a cynical Alucard. Godbrand voices a suspicion about Dracula's motives.

2-4.title: Broken Mast
2-4.overview: As Godbrand's thirst grows stronger, Carmilla tries to recruit Hector. Isaac shows his loyalty, and Belmont shares a family story with Sypha.

2-5.title: Last Spell
2-5.overview: Carmilla presses forward with her plan despite Godbrand's disappearance. Sypha makes a startling discovery while combing the archives.

2-6.title: The River
2-6.overview: Does he really have what it takes to live up to his family's reputation? It's time for Belmont to pick his fate. Also, Dracula prepares for the fight.

2-7.title: For Love
2-7.overview: With nothing less than the future of humanity at stake, Belmont, Alucard and Sypha do battle with their immortal enemy: Dracula.

2-8.title: End Times
2-8.overview: With the war between humans and vampires seemingly settled, the survivors -- both good and evil -- look toward the future.

3-1.title: Bless Your Dead Little Hearts
3-1.overview: Alucard adjusts to his lonely new life, Belmont and Sypha pay a visit to an eerie and unusual town, and Carmilla returns home with a prize.

3-2.title: The Reparation of My Heart
3-2.overview: Isaac gets some unexpected help in his search for Hector. Meanwhile, Carmilla plots a land grab and Alucard meets some fans.

3-3.title: Investigators
3-3.overview: Belmont and Sypha's plan to leave Lindenfeld hits a snag. Isaac and the Captain debate the merits of humanity. Hector tries to get a read on Lenore.

3-4.title: I Have a Scheme
3-4.overview: Sumi and Taka share their history with Alucard. Also, Saint Germain gains entrance to the priory, and Isaac receives an icy welcome in Genoa.

3-5.title: A Seat of Civilisation and Refinement
3-5.overview: Belmont and the Judge discover an ominous symbol, Saint Germain's treasure hunt is cut short, and Alucard's bond with Sumi and Taka continues to grow.

3-6.title: The Good Dream
3-6.overview: Lenore continues to spend time with Hector, slowly earning his trust. Saint Germain experiences a telling nightmare about the Infinite Corridor.

3-7.title: Worse Things Than Betrayal
3-7.overview: As Saint Germain makes unsettling discoveries, Isaac marches toward a showdown. Meanwhile, Belmont and Sypha question a monk — aggressively.

3-8.title: What the Night Brings
3-8.overview: Something is alive in the priory's basement, and for Belmont and Sypha, time is of the essence. Lenore opens up to Hector about Carmilla's plans.

3-9.title: The Harvest
3-9.overview: Night falls on Lindenfeld and all manner of hell breaks loose. Also, Isaac meets the Magician, Hector makes a pledge, and Sumi and Taka make a move.

3-10.title: Abandon All Hope
3-10.overview: With the portal to hell open, Trevor and Sypha must battle an onslaught. Meanwhile, the Judge shares a disturbing legacy, and Hector learns his fate.

4-1.title: Murder Wakes It Up
4-1.overview: Belmont and Sypha continue to battle beasts loyal to Dracula, but it's getting a little old. Meanwhile, Alucard receives a guest.

4-2.title: Having the World
4-2.overview: Lenore urges Hector to not test Carmilla's patience. Belmont and Sypha cross paths with Zamfir, a fearsome guard with a suspicious mind.

4-3.title: Walk Away
4-3.overview: Isaac gets under Varney's skin. Vampires Morana and Striga receive an urgent message from Carmilla. Belmont and Sypha get a look at Targoviste.

4-4.title: You Must Sacrifice
4-4.overview: Alucard travels to Danesti, where he makes a dramatic entrance in the nick of time. Also, the scholar Saint Germain reflects on his own twisted path.

4-5.title: Back in the World
4-5.overview: With Greta's help, Alucard sets out to guide the villagers to his castle for protection. Sypha pushes back on Zamfir's leadership. Isaac makes a move.

4-6.title: You Don't Deserve My Blood
4-6.overview: As Isaac and his army of night creatures descend on Carmilla's castle, Hector rushes to finish his preparations before the bloody reunion begins.

4-7.title: The Great Work
4-7.overview: Varney and Ratko discover their plan is working — but who gets the credit? Also, Zamfir finally takes Belmont and Sypha underground.

4-8.title: Death Magic
4-8.overview: Belmont, Sypha and Zamfir battle Varney, Ratko and their unholy army. Alucard's castle falls under attack, and Saint Germain shares his scheme.

4-9.title: The Endings
4-9.overview: Belmont and Sypha join forces with their old friend Alucard — and not a moment too soon. As the battle rages, Varney reveals his true form.

4-10.title: It's Been a Strange Ride
4-10.overview: Not content to live in a cage, Lenore chooses another fate. Alucard opens his castle. Sypha wonders if she's lost Belmont for good.

279830.name: Your Lie in April
279830.overview: Kousei Arima was a genius pianist until his mother's sudden death took away his ability to play. Each day was dull for Kousei. But, then he meets a violinist named Kaori Miyazono who has an eccentric playing style. Can the heartfelt sounds of the girl's violin lead the boy to play the piano again?

similar.name: The Fragrant Flower Blooms with Dignity

1-1.title: Monotone / Colorful
1-1.overview: Kousei's life has been dull and gray. His friends Tsubaki and Watari try their best to cheer him up but there's not more color in his life; His eyes don't sparkle.  However, there's this new girl who might just be able to change all that.

1-2.title: Friend A
1-2.overview: Kousei, Tsubaki & Watari sit down to watch Kaori's performance which ends up being completely unlike anything else they've seen. Kaori just seems to have a way with music completely different to how Kousei was taught.

1-3.title: Inside Spring
1-3.overview: Kousei and Kaori spend some time together and get to talking about Kousei's past. Will he ever be able to play a piano again? What happens if he can never overcome his fear, will color ever return to his life?

1-4.title: Departure
1-4.overview: Kousei and Kaori arrive just in time for the competition, however without a chance to practice the piece how will Kousei be able to perform? And how can he survive on stage with the memories of his mother still haunting him?

1-5.title: Gray Skies
1-5.overview: Kaori is recovering from her accident after the performance, and Kousei, Watari, and Tsubaki are starting to realise the new feelings that are brewing in their group.

1-6.title: On the Way Home
1-6.overview: Kaori is pushing Kousei to the limits in an attempt to bring back his musical skills. Tsubaki has to figure out where her feelings are pointing her.

1-7.title: The Shadows Whisper
1-7.overview: The Maihou Music Competition has started and Kousei is starting to feel his fears catching up with him. At the same time some old rivals have appeared and are set on competing with Kousei.

1-8.title: Let It Ring
1-8.overview: Takeshi Aiza and Emi Igawa. These two have a strong rivalry with Kousei. But what drives them to play piano?

1-9.title: Resonance
1-9.overview: It's Kousei's turn to take the stage, and everyone is waiting to see whether or not he will be able to play. How will he be able to perform with the memories of his mother still floating in his mind?

1-10.title: The Scenery I Shared with You
1-10.overview: During the Maihou Music Competition, Kousei has trouble hearing the notes. He tries drawing on dear memories to help him through his performance.

1-11.title: Light of Life
1-11.overview: The qualifiers are up, but Kousei is sure he already knows where he placed. Takeshi and Emi however are desperate to see how their greatest rival was marked.

1-12.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
1-12.overview: School's over and Summer break has begun, as long as you're not in Summer School. For Kousei and Kaori though there's not break yet, as they have to prepare for the Gala Concert. Tsubaki though just wants to spend whatever time she can with her friends, as the future is so uncertain. Can Saki help Kousei hear the music?

1-13.title: Love's Sorrow
1-13.overview: Kousei has taken the stage at the Gala Concert. Endeavoring to put on a performance without Kaori. This is his chance to prove his abilities as a pianist and try to come to terms with the memory of his mother.

1-14.title: Footsteps
1-14.overview: Kousei, Tsubaki and Watari visit Kaori in the hospital, but she insists everything is fine. Tsubaki reflects on her past with Kousei and considers if she has romantic feelings for him. Meanwhile, Kousei makes an important decision about his future.

1-15.title: Liar
1-15.overview: Tsubaki is frustrated as she sees her friends moving forward, afraid that she might be left behind. Kousei finds it difficult to keep visiting Kaori in the hospital. Hiroko comes across a promising young talent.

1-16.title: Two of a Kind
1-16.overview: Kousei's concerns for Kaori temporarily subside as he runs into her on the street and they go shopping. Nagi can't take the harsh criticism she receives with Kousei as her piano teacher.

1-17.title: Twilight
1-17.overview: Nagi is feeling the pressure of her upcoming performance, and is struggling to deal with it. But as she learns, every performer goes through the same emotions.

1-18.title: Hearts Come Together
1-18.overview: Nagi and Kousei finally take the stage. Despite acting as Nagi's support during their performance, Kousei challenges Nagi to reach her full potential.

1-19.title: Goodbye, Hero
1-19.overview: After Nagi and Kousei's performance Takeshi is pumped. It's his turn to take the stage. What will his music say about himself? What will he convey to the audience?

1-20.title: Hand in Hand
1-20.overview: Unable to come to grips with the idea that Kousei has feelings for Kaori, Tsubaki lashes out. Kousei, meanwhile, continues to avoid visiting Kaori in the hospital.

1-21.title: Snow
1-21.overview: Kousei breaks down and stops playing piano after he witnesses Kaori's health waning. The Eastern Japan Piano Competition continues.

1-22.title: Spring Wind
1-22.overview: Knowing her time is limited, Kaori undergoes a risky operation, hoping to have the chance to play with Kousei on stage one more time.

305288.name: Stranger Things
305288.overview: When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying supernatural forces, and one strange little girl.

1-1.title: Chapter One: The Vanishing of Will Byers
1-1.overview: On his way home from a friend's house, young Will sees something terrifying. Nearby, a sinister secret lurks in the depths of a government lab.

1-2.title: Chapter Two: The Weirdo on Maple Street
1-2.overview: Lucas, Mike and Dustin try to talk to the girl they found in the woods. Hopper questions an anxious Joyce about an unsettling phone call.

1-3.title: Chapter Three: Holly, Jolly
1-3.overview: An increasingly concerned Nancy looks for Barb and finds out what Jonathan's been up to. Joyce is convinced Will is trying to talk to her.

1-4.title: Chapter Four: The Body
1-4.overview: Refusing to believe Will is dead, Joyce tries to connect with her son. The boys give Eleven a makeover. Nancy and Jonathan form an unlikely alliance.

1-5.title: Chapter Five: The Flea and the Acrobat
1-5.overview: Hopper breaks into the lab while Nancy and Jonathan confront the force that took Will. The boys ask Mr. Clarke how to travel to another dimension.

1-6.title: Chapter Six: The Monster
1-6.overview: A frantic Jonathan looks for Nancy in the darkness, but Steve's looking for her, too. Hopper and Joyce uncover the truth about the lab's experiments.

1-7.title: Chapter Seven: The Bathtub
1-7.overview: Eleven struggles to reach Will, while Lucas warns that "the bad men are coming." Nancy and Jonathan show the police what Jonathan caught on camera.

1-8.title: Chapter Eight: The Upside Down
1-8.overview: Dr. Brenner holds Hopper and Joyce for questioning while the boys wait with Eleven in the gym. Back at Will's, Nancy and Jonathan prepare for battle.

2-1.title: Chapter One: MADMAX
2-1.overview: As the town preps for Halloween, a high-scoring rival shakes things up at the arcade, and a skeptical Hopper inspects a field of rotting pumpkins.

2-2.title: Chapter Two: Trick or Treat, Freak
2-2.overview: After Will sees something terrible on trick-or-treat night, Mike wonders whether Eleven's still out there. Nancy wrestles with the truth about Barb.

2-3.title: Chapter Three: The Pollywog
2-3.overview: Dustin adopts a strange new pet, and Eleven grows increasingly impatient. A well-meaning Bob urges Will to stand up to his fears.

2-4.title: Chapter Four: Will the Wise
2-4.overview: An ailing Will opens up to Joyce -- with disturbing results. While Hopper digs for the truth, Eleven unearths a surprising discovery.

2-5.title: Chapter Five: Dig Dug
2-5.overview: Nancy and Jonathan swap conspiracy theories with a new ally as Eleven searches for someone from her past. “Bob the Brain” tackles a difficult problem.

2-6.title: Chapter Six: The Spy
2-6.overview: Will's connection to a shadowy evil grows stronger, but no one's quite sure how to stop it. Elsewhere, Dustin and Steve forge an unlikely bond.

2-7.title: Chapter Seven: The Lost Sister
2-7.overview: Psychic visions draw Eleven to a band of violent outcasts and an angry girl with a shadowy past.

2-8.title: Chapter Eight: The Mind Flayer
2-8.overview: An unlikely hero steps forward when a deadly development puts the Hawkins Lab on lockdown, trapping Will and several others inside.

2-9.title: Chapter Nine: The Gate
2-9.overview: Eleven makes plans to finish what she started while the survivors turn up the heat on the monstrous force that's holding Will hostage.

3-1.title: Chapter One: Suzie, Do You Copy?
3-1.overview: Summer brings new jobs and budding romance. But the mood shifts when Dustin's radio picks up a Russian broadcast, and Will senses something is wrong.

3-2.title: Chapter Two: The Mall Rats
3-2.overview: Nancy and Jonathan follow a lead, Steve and Robin sign on to a secret mission, and Max and Eleven go shopping. A rattled Billy has troubling visions.

3-3.title: Chapter Three: The Case of the Missing Lifeguard
3-3.overview: With El and Max looking for Billy, Will declares a day without girls. Steve and Dustin go on a stakeout, and Joyce and Hopper return to Hawkins Lab.

3-4.title: Chapter Four: The Sauna Test
3-4.overview: A code red brings the gang back together to face a frighteningly familiar evil. Karen urges Nancy to keep digging, and Robin finds a useful map.

3-5.title: Chapter Five: The Flayed
3-5.overview: Strange surprises lurk inside an old farmhouse and deep beneath the Starcourt Mall. Meanwhile, the Mind Flayer is gathering strength.

3-6.title: Chapter Six: E Pluribus Unum
3-6.overview: Dr. Alexei reveals what the Russians have been building, and Eleven sees where Billy has been. Dustin and Erica stage a daring rescue.

3-7.title: Chapter Seven: The Bite
3-7.overview: With time running out -- and an assassin close behind -- Hopper's crew races back to Hawkins, where El and the kids are preparing for war.

3-8.title: Chapter Eight: The Battle of Starcourt
3-8.overview: Terror reigns in the food court when the Mind Flayer comes to collect. But down below, in the dark, the future of the world is at stake.

4-1.title: Chapter One: The Hellfire Club
4-1.overview: El is bullied at school. Joyce opens a mysterious package. A scrappy player shakes up D&D night.

4-2.title: Chapter Two: Vecna's Curse
4-2.overview: A plane brings Mike to California — and a dead body brings Hawkins to a halt. Nancy goes looking for leads. A shaken Eddie tells the gang what he saw.

4-3.title: Chapter Three: The Monster and the Superhero
4-3.overview: Murray and Joyce fly to Alaska, and El faces serious consequences. Robin and Nancy dig up dirt on Hawkins' demons. Dr. Owens delivers sobering news.

4-4.title: Chapter Four: Dear Billy
4-4.overview: Max is in grave danger... and running out of time. A patient at Pennhurst asylum has visitors. Elsewhere, in Russia, Hopper is hard at work.

4-5.title: Chapter Five: The Nina Project
4-5.overview: Owens takes El to Nevada, where she's forced to confront her past, while the Hawkins kids comb a crumbling house for clues. Vecna claims another victim.

4-6.title: Chapter Six: The Dive
4-6.overview: Behind the Iron Curtain, a risky rescue mission gets underway. The California crew seeks help from a hacker. Steve takes one for the team.

4-7.title: Chapter Seven: The Massacre at Hawkins Lab
4-7.overview: As Hopper braces to battle a monster, Dustin dissects Vecna's motives — and decodes a message from beyond. El finds strength in a distant memory.

4-8.title: Chapter Eight: Papa
4-8.overview: Nancy has sobering visions, and El passes an important test. Back in Hawkins, the gang gathers supplies and prepares for battle.

4-9.title: Chapter Nine: The Piggyback
4-9.overview: With selfless hearts and a clash of metal, heroes fight from every corner of the battlefield to save Hawkins — and the world itself.

412931.name: Family Matter
412931.overview: Ibrahim is a set-in-his-ways man who is blindsided on his birthday when he's forced to become the legal guardian of a daughter he never knew — a young woman who is equally reluctant to have him in her life. What begins as an awkward obligation slowly transforms both of them. Starring Maged El Kedwany, this warm comedy-drama about absent fathers, second chances and unexpected family bonds ran for multiple seasons on Shahid.

1-1.title: Episode 1
1-1.overview: Ibrahim hates surprises but his birthday is full of them. One comes from his father-in-law who hasn’t spoken to him in years.

1-2.title: Episode 2
1-2.overview: Due to his distrust of his son Khaled, Munir is about to burden Ibrahim with a large responsibility. Khaled tries to get himself out of trouble.

1-3.title: Episode 3
1-3.overview: Ibrahim’s journey as Sarah’s guardian starts off on the wrong foot as Zainab, in her desire to meet her niece, makes a move that risks revealing his lies.

1-4.title: Episode 4
1-4.overview: Sarah’s visit to her biological family stirs feelings in her. After being threatened, Khaled redoubles his efforts to seize control of the company.

1-5.title: Episode 5
1-5.overview: Sarah decides to spend the night at Zainab’s place where she feels safer. Khaled finds himself in hot water and resorts to blackmailing Ibrahim.

1-6.title: Episode 6
1-6.overview: In Marsa Alam, Ibrahim enlists Hassan’s help in keeping his real profession secret from Sarah, but things don’t turn out to be as easy as they expected.

1-7.title: Episode 7
1-7.overview: As his love and attachment for his daughter grow, Ibrahim almost confesses the truth, but an unexpected encounter may just beat him to the punch.

1-8.title: Episode 8
1-8.overview: Upon his return from Marsa Alam, Ibrahim is ambushed by Khaled who puts on an act and claims that Ghazi threatened Sarah.

1-9.title: Episode 9
1-9.overview: The whole family works together to implement Ramadan’s plan and attempt to fix Ibrahim’s mistake.

1-10.title: Episode 10
1-10.overview: SEASON FINALE: Sarah confronts Ibrahim and his family about their lie. As Ghazi’s patience runs out, Khaled makes a last-ditch effort to take over the company.

2-1.title: Episode 1
2-1.overview: Zeinab urges Ibrahim to consult a doctor after he finds himself constantly forgetting things. Hassan prepares a surprise for Sarah on her graduation.

2-2.title: Episode 2
2-2.overview: Ibrahim decides to keep the truth about his diagnosis from his family who visit him at his request. Despite his fears, Ibrahim calls the new doctor.

2-3.title: Episode 3
2-3.overview: A misunderstanding between Maryam and Imad puts Ibrahim in an embarrassing position. Tensions rise between Sarah and Hassan because of her jealousy.

2-4.title: Episode 4
2-4.overview: To avoid his secret being revealed, Ibrahim makes an unusual move. Sarah and Hassan have a falling out. Zeinab suspects Ramadan of cheating on her.

2-5.title: Episode 5
2-5.overview: Ibrahim, Sarah and Zeinab trap Hassan. Mariam’s ex-husband walks into her clinic to threaten her. Sarah worries about her future children’s wellbeing.

2-6.title: Episode 6
2-6.overview: Ibrahim, Sarah and Hassan urgently travel to Hurghada to save Khaled from Umm Laith. When Ibrahim doesn’t answer her phone calls, Mariam decides to pay him a visit.

2-7.title: Episode 7
2-7.overview: When Ibrahim returns home, he finds out about the shocking excuse Ramadan used to justify Mariam’s presence to Zainab. Khaled asks Sarah to lend him three million dollars.

2-8.title: Episode 8
2-8.overview: The entire group goes on a hike in a forest filled with wild animals where they make an unpleasant acquaintance and lose their guide.

2-9.title: Episode 9
2-9.overview: Ramadan’s weak English gets him and Zeinab into unexpected trouble after eating a piece of cake. Ibrahim forgets a task he was assigned by Khaled and leaves him stranded.

2-10.title: Episode 10
2-10.overview: After receiving a call from the gang requesting the necklace in exchange for Khaled’s life, Ibrahim asks Ghazi for help. Later, Ibrahim and Mariam meet the doctor.

2-11.title: Episode 11
2-11.overview: After his visit to the doctor leaves him on edge, Ibrahim forces Sarah to get married, regardless of her reservations. Zeinab asks Ramadan for divorce.

2-12.title: Episode 12
2-12.overview: SEASON FINALE: Mariam decides to reveal Ibrahim's secret and tell his family about his deteriorating health and urgent need for an operation.

3-1.title: Episode 1
3-1.overview: Ibrahim, now a trending cooking show host, is implicated in a crime alongside Khaled and Ghazi. The police show up and deliver news that leaves the family in shock.

3-2.title: Episode 2
3-2.overview: Threatened with eviction due to Aabla’s forged lawsuit, the family struggles to find a solution. But the situation worsens when the tax authorities seize Sarah's funds.

3-3.title: Episode 3
3-3.overview: The family scrapes together every penny to pay Sarah's taxes. Forced to leave the hotel, they move into Maryam’s clinic. Ibrahim confronts Aabla, only to be shocked by her unexpected demand.

3-4.title: Episode 4
3-4.overview: Aabla admits to orchestrating the family's misfortunes and demands Ibrahim marry her to drop the lawsuit. He refuses, but chaos ensues when Khaled and Ghazi propose a malicious plan—and secretly put it into action.

3-5.title: Episode 5
3-5.overview: Khaled and Ghazi burn the motel down for insurance money to clear their debts. A shocking discovery in the wreckage leaves Ibrahim guilty. Meanwhile, Aabla pressures Ibrahim, revealing one striking truth after another.

3-6.title: Episode 6
3-6.overview: Ibrahim tentatively agrees to marry Aabla secretly but stalls for time. Meanwhile, he shelters Jaber’s orphaned children. As Aabla plans a public wedding, Ibrahim juggles mounting crises and keeping secrets.

3-7.title: Episode 7
3-7.overview: Jaber’s children spark jealousy in the family, as rumours swirl about their connection to Ibrahim. Adding to Ibrahim's stress, Khaled and Ghazi enter the business world with a bold new venture.

3-8.title: Episode 8
3-8.overview: Tensions boil over when Sarah accuses Shaimaa of theft. Meanwhile, Aabla kidnaps Ibrahim. Amidst rising chaos, the family is left reeling as secrets unravel and loyalties are tested.

3-9.title: Episode 9
3-9.overview: Ibrahim wakes up confused on a remote beach. After fighting with Maryam, Aabla exposes Ibrahim’s lies and plans.

3-10.title: Episode 10
3-10.overview: Ibrahim makes a damning confession to his family and loses their trust. Grappling with guilt, he decides to turn himself in. Later, the family's life unravels as unexpected evidence surfaces.

377543.name: JUJUTSU KAISEN
377543.overview: Yuji Itadori is a boy with tremendous physical strength, though he lives a completely ordinary high school life. One day, to save a classmate who has been attacked by curses, he eats the finger of Ryomen Sukuna, taking the curse into his own soul. From then on, he shares one body with Ryomen Sukuna. Guided by the most powerful of sorcerers, Satoru Gojo, Itadori is admitted to Tokyo Jujutsu High School, an organization that fights the curses... and thus begins the heroic tale of a boy who became a curse to exorcise a curse, a life from which he could never turn back.

similar.name: The Irregular at Magic High School

1-1.title: Ryomen Sukuna
1-1.overview: After visiting his beloved grandfather in the hospital, Yuji Itadori encounters an apprentice sorcerer who demands that Yuji hand over a cursed relic.

1-2.title: For Myself
1-2.overview: Yuji manages to control the curse of Ryomen Sukuna. Later, he awakens in a room with Jujutsu High teacher Satoru Gojo, who offers him a deadly choice.

1-3.title: Girl of Steel
1-3.overview: Nobara Kugisaki joins the class on a trip to Roppongi where Gojo gives her and Yuji their first test: dispel a curse from an abandoned building.

1-4.title: Curse Womb Must Die
1-4.overview: When a curse womb attacks a juvenile detention center, Yuji's group is called upon to rescue any remaining survivors — but combat isn’t an option.

1-5.title: Curse Womb Must Die -II-
1-5.overview: As Sukuna gruesomely holds Yuji's body hostage, Fushiguro struggles against the sheer strength of Sukuna's curse to buy time until Yuji can awaken.

1-6.title: After Rain
1-6.overview: Sukuna tells Yuji that he will bring him back to life on two conditions. Meanwhile, Suguru Geto and a cursed spirit discuss their plans for Gojo.

1-7.title: Assault
1-7.overview: The cursed spirit Jogo attacks Gojo, who has such little trouble fighting back that he leaves and brings back a student to observe the battle.

1-8.title: Boredom
1-8.overview: As Kugisaki and Fushiguro train for the exchange event, two older students from the Kyoto Jujutsu school arrive in Tokyo and pick a fight with them.

1-9.title: Small Fry and Reverse Retribution
1-9.overview: High schooler Junpei Yoshino finds his bullies horrifically killed in a movie theater. Sorcerer Kento Nanami and Yuji investigate the crime scene.

1-10.title: Idle Transfiguration
1-10.overview: Junpei gets some startling advice from Mahito. Later, Ijichi and Yuji track down Junpei and formulate a plan to set up a chance encounter with him.

1-11.title: Narrow-minded
1-11.overview: Annoyed at having to work off the clock, Nanami shows Mahito the true potential of his sorcery. Meanwhile, Yuji and Junpei bond over movies.

1-12.title: To You, Someday
1-12.overview: Ignoring Nanami's warning, Yuji dashes into the school and tries to reason with Junpei, but Mahito soon interrupts. Yuji appeals to Sukuna for help.

1-13.title: Tomorrow
1-13.overview: Yuji and Nanami coordinate their attacks on Mahito, wearing him down. But as the cursed spirit approaches death, he finds a new power within himself.

1-14.title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 0 -
1-14.overview: With the exchange event between the Tokyo and Kyoto Jujutsu schools set to begin, Gojo arranges for Yuji to make a surprise appearance.

1-15.title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 1 -
1-15.overview: Shortly after the exchange event team battle begins, Todo ambushes the Tokyo students. Yuji moves to stop him but soon finds himself surrounded.

1-16.title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 2 -
1-16.overview: Todo gives Yuji advice on how to better tap into his curse powers. After Kugisaki taunts Nishimiya, Panda fights the remote-controlled Mechamaru.

1-17.title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 3 -
1-17.overview: While Miwa struggles to stand her ground against Maki's attacks, Kugisaki chases down a flying Nishimiya, who lectures her about Mai's hardships.

1-18.title: Sage
1-18.overview: Fushiguro dodges Kamo's barrage of arrows but his opponent proves just as formidable in close combat. Meanwhile, Inumaki senses a foreboding presence.

1-19.title: Black Flash
1-19.overview: Inumaki, Fushiguro and Kamo struggle to hold their own against special grade cursed spirit Hanami, but Maki arrives to provide much-needed backup.

1-20.title: Nonstandard
1-20.overview: After analyzing Hanami's assortment of skills with his self-proclaimed intellect, Todo uses his disorienting technique to attack in tandem with Yuji.

1-21.title: Jujutsu Koshien
1-21.overview: After the event's interruption, the school tournament continues with a baseball match.

1-22.title: The Origin of Blind Obedience
1-22.overview: An investigation into a string of curse-related killings leads Yuji, Fushiguro and Kugisaki to the victims' – and Fushiguro's – former middle school.

1-23.title: The Origin of Blind Obedience -II-
1-23.overview: Fushiguro, Kugisaki and Itadori fight the cursed spirits on two fronts. When Fushiguro faces his enemy alone, he recalls his recent training with Gojo. He knows that he has to be able to surpass himself...

1-24.title: Accomplices
1-24.overview: Yuji and Nobara's battle against the Death Painting Wombs Kechizu and Eso reaches its conclusion! However, even in victory there is a cost in killing, something the Jujutsu High students had never considered before. Meanwhile, Choso, Geto and Mahito gain wind of this event.

1-25.title: Hidden Inventory
1-25.overview: The jujutsu sorcerers Iori Utahime and Mei Mei are dispatched to an ominous manor where several people have gone missing. They infiltrate the manor and attempt to destroy the cursed spirit's barrier, but suddenly the building starts to crumble.

1-26.title: Hidden Inventory 2
1-26.overview: Gojo and Geto are assigned to the mission of escorting and erasing the young girl compatible with the Tengen - the Star Plasma Vessel. Amanai Riko is being targeted by the Curse User Group Q, and the religious cult the Star Religious Group.

1-27.title: Hidden Inventory 3
1-27.overview: Gojo and Geto beat back the curse users after the bounty placed on Amanai's head when her cell phone rings. A captured Kuroi is displayed on her phone. Gojo tries to bring Amanai back to Jujutsu High, but she insists on going to the negotiations herself.

1-28.title: Hidden Inventory 4
1-28.overview: "Let's go home, Riko-chan." The moment Geto extends a hand to Amanai, the worst that could possibly happen does. Geto is left dumbstruck as Toji Fushiguro makes his appearance. Toji then declares that he killed Satoru Gojo.

1-29.title: Premature Death
1-29.overview: August 2007. Gojo starts to handle missions on his own, causing Geto to, as well. One day a certain individual appears before Geto. What's the conclusion that led to Gojo becoming the strongest jujutsu sorcerer, and Geto becoming the most evil curse user?

1-30.title: It's Like That
1-30.overview: 2018. After finishing a mission one day, Itadori decides to go to the movies, Kugisaki decides to go shopping, and Fushiguro tells them he's going home. After parting ways Kugisaki is approached by a woman who suddenly asks if she was with Itadori-kun.

1-31.title: Evening Festival
1-31.overview: The battle between Muta and Mahito continues and reaches its conclusion. Later, on October 31st, a veil is lowered over Shibuya and various jujutsu sorcerer teams assemble around the area.

1-32.title: Shibuya Incident
1-32.overview: Team Mei Mei are reassigned to a veil that has been lowered over Meiji Shrine Station. The team splits up and Yuji encounters a grasshopper curse assigned to protecting the veil. Elsewhere Satoru Gojo encounters Jogo, Hanami, and Choso.

1-33.title: Shibuya Incident - Gate, Open
1-33.overview: The battle between Satoru Gojo, Jogo, Hanami and Choso begins. Gojo informs Hanami that they will die first. Yuji encounters a woman who tells him that everyone was turned into monsters and boarded a train. As Gojo's battle continues, the train arrives.

1-34.title: Pandemonium
1-34.overview: Now that Satoru Gojo has been sealed, Mechamaru works with Team Mei Mei to inform them about what is going on and has them work on enacting his plan on what to do now.

1-35.title: Seance
1-35.overview: Nanami, Fushiguro, and Ino meet up with Itadori, then Nanami issues new orders for the others to work together to lift the veil keeping sorcerers out.

1-36.title: Dull Knife
1-36.overview: Yuji and Megumi lift the veil that was keeping sorcerers from entering Shibuya. Nobara and Nitta encounter Shigemo and a battle ensues. Shigemo has the upperhand, but then Nanami arrives with the deaths of the assistant supervisors in mind.

1-37.title: Red Scale
1-37.overview: Yuji makes his way to Shibuya Station where he's confronted by Choso. Choso unleashes his Convergence and the battle between him and Yuji commences.

1-38.title: Fluctuations
1-38.overview: Mei Mei and Ui Ui fight the Special-Grade Disease Curse summoned by whatever is pretending to be Suguru Geto. Meanwhile, Nanami joins up with Maki and Naobito, but they encounter a cursed spirit with unknown powers.

1-39.title: Fluctuations (2)
1-39.overview: Nanami, Maki, and Naobito are driven to the edge after the Special-Grade Cursed Spirit, Dagon, activates his Domain Expansion, Horizon of the Captivating Skandha. Fushiguro gives them a glimpse of a way to escape death, then Toji intrudes upon the fight.

1-40.title: Thunderclap
1-40.overview: Sukuna refuses to heed Jogo's advice after waking up, instead displaying his overwhelming strength against the Special-Grade Cursed Spirit, Jogo. Meanwhile, Fushiguro faces off against the rampant Toji with neither being aware of the other's identity.

1-41.title: Thunderclap (2)
1-41.overview: After being severely injured in his fight against Toji, Fushiguro suffers a surprise attack from Shigemo. On the verge of death, Fushiguro desperately heads toward Dougenzaka crossing and summons a certain Shikigami with his Ten Shadows Technique.

1-42.title: Right and Wrong
1-42.overview: Itadori reawakens with grievous resolve as he bears witness to the aftermath Sukuna has wrought upon Shibuya. Meanwhile, Nanami continues to fight through packs of transfigured humans in an exhausted haze until Mahito appears before him.

1-43.title: Right and Wrong (2)
1-43.overview: Itadori launches into a back-and-forth battle against Mahito, but he struggles against Mahito's ploy of using average people against him. Meanwhile, Kugisaki encounters one of Mahito's separated bodies as she returns to the battlefield.

1-44.title: Right and Wrong (3)
1-44.overview: Itadori stands in a daze at the disaster before his eyes, his mind already well past its limit. As a curse, Mahito is elated at seeing his ideal sequence of events play out before him, and he prepares to further finish off Itadori.

1-45.title: Metamorphosis
1-45.overview: After rescuing Itadori from his predicament, Todo bolsters his morale and encourages him to stand back up. As Mahito kicks things into higher gear, he begins using Soul Multiplicity and Body Repel to unleash omnidirectional attacks.

1-46.title: Metamorphosis (2)
1-46.overview: The moment it appeared Itadori and Mahito's battle to the death was resolved, the being wearing Geto's body asked, "Shall I save you, Mahito?" Itadori immediately recognizes the man before him as the very same one who sealed away Gojo and leaps to attack.

1-47.title: Shibuya Incident - Gate, Close
1-47.overview: Choso begins to realize the identity of the mastermind parasitizing Geto's corpse as sorcerers gather for the final moments of the Shibuya Incident. The special-grade sorcerer, Yuki Tsukumo, comes to the rescue when they're on the verge of death.

1-48.title: Execution
1-48.overview: While Yuji grapples with the weight of his sins, Naoya Zen'in and Yuta Okkotsu set out to execute him.

1-49.title: One More Time
1-49.overview: After fighting Yuta, Yuji learns his real objective. Megumi asks for Yuji's help to save his sister.

1-50.title: About the Culling Game
1-50.overview: Itadori and his friends speak with Tengen about Kenjaku's objectives and their plans for the Culling Game.

1-51.title: Perfect Preparation
1-51.overview: After going to collect their Cursed Tools, Maki awakens her true potential & slaughters the whole Zen'in Clan.

1-52.title: Passion
1-52.overview: Yaga is executed. Yuji and Fushiguro go to Hakari's fight club hoping to meet him and recruit him.

1-53.title: Cog
1-53.overview: Fushiguro and Panda fight Kirara to try and persuade them while Yuji attempts to convince Hakari.

1-54.title: Tokyo Colony No. 1
1-54.overview: Yuji's group enters two of the colonies and fight the Culling Game's newbie hunters.

1-55.title: Tokyo Colony No. 1 (2)
1-55.overview: Yuji meets Higuruma and tries to persuade him, while Fushiguro is falsely led to Reggie.

1-57.title: Tokyo Colony No. 1 (4)
1-57.overview: Takaba handles the minions while Fushiguro has his showdown with Reggie.

1-58.title: Tokyo Colony No. 1 (5)
1-58.overview: Fushiguro deploys his Domain Expansion in his climatic fight against Reggie.

1-59.title: Sendai Colony
1-59.overview: Okkotsu fights three powerful sorcerers in Sendai Colony.

383275.name: Squid Game
383275.overview: Hundreds of cash-strapped players accept a strange invitation to compete in children's games. Inside, a tempting prize awaits — with deadly high stakes.

1-1.title: Red Light, Green Light
1-1.overview: Hoping to win easy money, a broke and desperate Gi-hun agrees to take part in an enigmatic game. Not long into the first round, unforeseen horrors unfold.

1-2.title: Hell
1-2.overview: Split on whether to continue or quit, the group holds a vote. But their realities in the outside world may prove to be just as unforgiving as the game.

1-3.title: The Man with the Umbrella
1-3.overview: A few players enter the next round — which promises equal doses of sweet and deadly — with hidden advantages. Meanwhile, Jun-ho sneaks his way inside.

1-4.title: Stick to the Team
1-4.overview: As alliances form among the players, no one is safe in the dorm after lights-out. The third game challenges Gi-hun's team to think strategically.

1-5.title: A Fair World
1-5.overview: Gi-hun and his team take turns keeping guard through the night. The masked men encounter trouble with their co-conspirators.

1-6.title: Gganbu
1-6.overview: Players pair off for the fourth game. Gi-hun grapples with a moral dilemma, Sang-woo chooses self-preservation and Sae-byeok shares her untold story.

1-7.title: VIPS
1-7.overview: The Masked Leader welcomes VIP guests to the facility for a front-row viewing of the show. In the fifth game, some players crack under pressure.

1-8.title: Front Man
1-8.overview: Ahead of the last round, distrust and disgust run deep among the finalists. Jun-ho makes a getaway, determined to expose the game's dirty secrets.

1-9.title: One Lucky Day
1-9.overview: The final round presents another cruel test — but this time, how it ends depends on just one player. The game's creator steps out of the shadows.

2-1.title: Bread and Lottery
2-1.overview: A vengeful Gi-hun makes a U-turn at the airport. Later, in his hideout, he intensifies his search for the elusive recruiter who is seeking new players.

2-2.title: Halloween Party
2-2.overview: Gi-hun finally gets hold of an invitation, marked for Halloween day. In a tense moment facing Jun-ho, they reveal their truths to each other.

2-3.overview: New players gather for a chance to win 45.6 billion won. After an intense first round, the survivors' fates hang in the balance — down to one final vote.

2-4.title: Six Legs
2-4.overview: The players prepare for the next game: a six-legged pentathlon, where each team member must clear a mini-game to survive — or face collective elimination.

2-5.title: One More Game
2-5.overview: Kang No-eul earns enemies for her unruly actions. Nerves fray to the breaking point as the remaining players vote on whether to move to the next round.

2-6.title: O ﻿ X
2-6.overview: Jun-ho and his team prepare to infiltrate a suspicious island. As monetary stakes and tensions rise, players split into two opposing factions.

2-7.title: Friend or Foe
2-7.overview: The remaining players strategize on how to survive the night. Gi-hun proposes a risky plan — but he will need trustworthy allies to carry it out.

3-1.title: Keys and Knives
3-1.overview: No-eul infiltrates a dangerous operation with a risky plan. A new game is announced: hide-and-seek, where one group holds a key and the other a knife.

3-2.title: The Starry Night
3-2.overview: The games resume, and Gi-hun fixates on confronting Kang Dae-ho. Meanwhile, Kim Jun-hee faces a sudden crisis that pushes her willpower to its limits.

3-3.title: It's Not Your Fault
3-3.overview: Jun-ho's team gets close to finding the island. Jang Geum-ja makes a desperate plea to Gi-hun to help Jun-hee. The VIPs discuss a cruel proposal.

3-4.overview: Even as Gi-hun supports Jun-hee amid rising tensions, she must make a pivotal decision. Before the final game, the Front Man gives Gi-hun an ultimatum.

3-5.overview: No-eul tries to gain the upper hand in negotiations, but her plans backfire. Gi-hun faces a moral crossroads, testing his limits — how far will he go?

3-6.title: Humans Are...
3-6.overview: As Jun-ho races to reach the island, tensions peak in the final round. The last players face an impossible situation in the closing minutes of the game.

334824.name: Dark
334824.overview: A missing child sets four families on a frantic hunt for answers as they unearth a mind-bending mystery that spans three generations.

1-1.title: Secrets
1-1.overview: In 2019, a local boy's disappearance stokes fear in the residents of Winden, a small German town with a strange and tragic history.

1-2.title: Lies
1-2.overview: When a grim discovery leaves the police baffled, Ulrich seeks a search warrant for the power plant. A mysterious stranger checks into the hotel.

1-3.title: Past and Present
1-3.overview: It's 1986, and Ulrich's brother, Mads, has been missing for a month. Confusion reigns as past and present intertwine.

1-4.title: Double Lives
1-4.overview: Bizarre occurrences give Charlotte a sense of déjà vu, and she suspects Peter is hiding something. Franziska snaps when Magnus confronts her.

1-5.title: Truths
1-5.overview: Hannah takes her obsession with Ulrich too far. The stranger asks Regina to deliver an important package. Martha is torn between Jonas and Bartosz.

1-6.title: Sic Mundus Creatus Est
1-6.overview: Ulrich looks to the past for answers and dredges up disturbing family secrets. Armed with new tools, Jonas probes the cave's murky depths.

1-7.title: Crossroads
1-7.overview: Ulrich questions a frail and frightened Helge in the nursing home. Jonas searches for Mikkel, but the stranger warns him about meddling with the past.

1-8.title: As You Sow, So You Shall Reap
1-8.overview: In 1953, the disfigured bodies of two boys are exhumed at a construction site, the future location of Winden's nuclear power plant.

1-9.title: Everything Is Now
1-9.overview: Ulrich runs afoul of the law, Helge tries to dodge Egon Tiedemann, Claudia harnesses the cave's powers, and Katharina lashes out at Hannah.

1-10.title: Alpha and Omega
1-10.overview: Peter gets a shock. Jonas learns the truth about his family, but there are more surprises still to come. Helge makes a sacrifice.

2-1.title: Beginnings and Endings
2-1.overview: Six months after the disappearances, the police form a task force. In 2052, Jonas learns that most of Winden perished in an apocalyptic event.

2-2.title: Dark Matter
2-2.overview: Clausen and Charlotte interview Regina. The Stranger takes Hannah to 1987, where Claudia has an unnerving encounter and Egon visits an old nemesis.

2-3.title: Ghosts
2-3.overview: In 1954, a missing Helge returns, but he'll only speak to Noah. In 1987, Claudia brings the time machine to Tannhaus, and Egon questions Ulrich again.

2-4.title: The Travelers
2-4.overview: Jonas meets an ominous figure. While the kids comb the cave for answers, the adults gather in the bunker to share what they know about the travelers.

2-5.title: Lost and Found
2-5.overview: In 1987, Ulrich seizes an opportunity. The kids return to the cave with the time machine, and Jonas learns of a loophole that could change the future.

2-6.title: An Endless Cycle
2-6.overview: Armed with a plan to prevent the apocalypse, Jonas travels to 2019. During the Nielsens' anniversary party, Ulrich sneaks off with Hannah.

2-7.title: The White Devil
2-7.overview: Martha meets the Stranger and learns his true identity. Claudia tries to prevent Egon's death in 1987. Hannah travels to 1954 to see Ulrich.

2-8.title: Endings and Beginnings
2-8.overview: On the day of the apocalypse, Clausen executes a search warrant at the power plant as Jonas and Claudia use the time machine to connect past and future.

330139.name: Violet Evergarden
330139.overview: The war is over, and Violet Evergarden needs a job. Scarred and emotionless, she takes a job as a letter writer to understand herself and her past.

1-1.title: Episode 1
1-1.overview: Hodgins retrieves Violet from the hospital, as Major Gilbert asked him to look out for her. After they meet Gilbert's relatives, he offers her a job.

1-2.title: Episode 2
1-2.overview: Violet tries to adjust to her new job: she needs to learn typing, and her coworkers question whether she has the right demeanor for letter writing.

1-3.title: Episode 3
1-3.overview: Violet enrolls in a Doll training course. Her classmate Luculia befriends her, though she has her own problems with her war veteran brother.

1-4.title: Episode 4
1-4.overview: When Iris goes to her home village on an assignment, Violet accompanies her. Iris's birthday party sparks a disagreement with her family.

1-5.title: Episode 5
1-5.overview: Princess Charlotte is to have a public correspondence with her betrothed, and Violet is entrusted with writing the letters on her highness’s behalf.

1-6.title: Episode 6
1-6.overview: Violet travels to the country of Astrea to work with transcribers copying damaged manuscripts. Her partner Leon has a past not unlike hers.

1-7.title: Episode 7
1-7.overview: A playwright with writer's block and a tragic past summons Violet to the country of Genetrix to help him finish a script. They both learn about grief.

1-8.title: Episode 8
1-8.overview: Violet learns that Major Gilbert is listed as missing in action, but his family members think he is dead. Unable to cope, she remembers the war.

1-9.title: Episode 9
1-9.overview: Heartbroken, Violet withdraws from her job and questions whether she even has the right to be an Auto Memory Doll. Then, she receives a letter.

1-10.title: Episode 10
1-10.overview: Violet travels to a countryside mansion to write a letter for a gravely ill war widow, but her young daughter Ann resents Violet's presence.

1-11.title: Episode 11
1-11.overview: Against Hodgins' wishes, Violet takes a job from a soldier at a military base in Ctrigall, a former enemy nation now engulfed in civil war.

1-12.title: Episode 12
1-12.overview: The Major's older brother is ordered to defend the signing ceremony from former Gardarik forces opposed to peace. Violet intercepts his train.

1-13.title: Episode 13
1-13.overview: The signing ceremony concludes, officially bringing an end to the war. While writing letters for an air show, Violet composes a letter to the Major.

371572.name: House of the Dragon
371572.overview: The Targaryen dynasty is at the absolute apex of its power, with more than 15 dragons under their yoke. Most empires crumble from such heights. In the case of the Targaryens, their slow fall begins when King Viserys breaks with a century of tradition by naming his daughter Rhaenyra heir to the Iron Throne. But when Viserys later fathers a son, the court is shocked when Rhaenyra retains her status as his heir, and seeds of division sow friction across the realm.

cast.name: Jefferson Hall
cast.character: Lord Jason Lannister / Ser Tyland Lannister

1-1.title: The Heirs of the Dragon
1-1.overview: Viserys hosts a tournament to celebrate the birth of his second child. Rhaenyra welcomes her uncle Daemon back to the Red Keep.

1-2.title: The Rogue Prince
1-2.overview: Princess Rhaenyra dives deep into the prophecies about House Targaryen while confronting a realm that resists the idea of a woman on the Iron Throne, and Prince Daemon, embittered over being passed over as the heir to Westeros, prepares to go to war.

1-3.title: Second of His Name
1-3.overview: Daemon and the Sea Snake battle the Crabfeeder. The realm celebrates Aegon's second nameday. Rhaenyra faces the prospect of marriage.

1-4.title: King of the Narrow Sea
1-4.overview: Daemon returns to court after the successful completion of the battle. Princess Rhaenyra must deal with potential suitors in order to keep her line of succession.

1-5.title: We Light the Way
1-5.overview: Daemon visits his wife in the Vale. Viserys and Rhaenyra broker agreements with the Valeryons. Alicent seeks the truth about the princess.

1-6.title: The Princess and the Queen
1-6.overview: Ten years later. Rhaenyra navigates Alicent's continued speculation about her children, while Daemon and Laena weigh an offer in Pentos.

1-7.title: Driftmark
1-7.overview: As the families gather on Driftmark for a funeral, Viserys calls for an end to infighting and Alicent demands justice.

1-8.title: The Lord of the Tides
1-8.overview: Six years later. With the Driftmark succession suddenly critical, Rhaenyra attempts to strike a bargain with Rhaenys.

1-9.title: The Green Council
1-9.overview: While Alicent enlists Cole and Aemond to track down Aegon, Otto gathers the great houses of Westeros to affirm their allegiance.

1-10.title: The Black Queen
1-10.overview: Mourning a tragic death, Rhaenyra tries to hold the kingdom together and Daemon prepares for war.

2-1.title: A Son for a Son
2-1.overview: While Rhaenyra struggles to come to terms with her son's murder, in King's Landing, Alicent grows concerned that Aegon's Small Council may lead them to an all-out war. Larys suggests Aegon needs a new Hand, and Rhaenyra arrives at a fateful decision.

2-2.title: Rhaenyra the Cruel
2-2.overview: As Otto schemes to turn the public against her, Rhaenyra questions Daemon's loyalty. Meanwhile, Ser Criston Cole concocts a misguided plan for revenge.

2-3.title: The Burning Mill
2-3.overview: As ancient grudges resurface, Rhaenys suggests that Alicent may see reason while the men around her seek bloodshed. Ser Criston proposes a bold scheme. Daemon arrives at Harrenhal to raise an army for the Blacks.

2-4.title: The Red Dragon and the Gold
2-4.overview: In Rhaenyra's absence and with no word from Daemon at Harrenhal, Rhaenys tries to keep the peace on the Black Council as Cole mounts a campaign into the Crownlands. In King's Landing, Aemond continues to undermine Aegon's fragile hold on authority.

2-5.title: Regent
2-5.overview: Amid whispers of bad omens, the Greens consider how to fill a void on Aegon's Council, Jacaerys sets out on a rogue mission to strike a deal, and Daemon enlists Lord Willem Blackwood to help persuade the Brackens to bend the knee.

2-6.title: Smallfolk
2-6.overview: With few options left, Rhaenyra summons a trusted knight for a risky venture and plots with Mysaria to catalyze the smallfolk. Meanwhile, Daemon's unease grows, and Aemond takes steps to reshape the Green Council.

2-7.title: The Red Sowing
2-7.overview: As Rhaenyra looks to gain an advantage by unusual means, Daemon pressures a young liege lord to raise up his bannermen.

2-8.title: The Queen Who Ever Was
2-8.overview: As Aemond becomes more volatile, Larys plots an escape, and Alicent grows more concerned about Helaena's safety. Flush with new power, Rhaenyra looks to press her advantage.

277165.name: Silicon Valley
277165.overview: In the high-tech gold rush of modern Silicon Valley, the people most qualified to succeed are the least capable of handling success.
